sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusikiliza na Kujibu (Theme 1: Usafi wa mazingira)
learning_experiences: kutambua vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusikiliza mjadala,
kutambua vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kuchangia mjadala,
kusikiliza au kutazama mjadala kuhusu suala lengwa katika kifaa cha kidijitali,
kueleza vipengele vya kusikiliza na kuchangia mjadala vilivyozingatiwa katika mjadala aliosikiliza,
kushiriki mjadala kuhusu suala lengwa akiwa na wenzake akizingatia vipengele vifaavyo vya mjadala.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unazingatia nini wakati wa kusikiliza na kuchangia mjadala?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuchangia ipasavyo katika shughuli za ujifunzaji kuhusu kusikiliza na kujibu mjadala.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kama vile redio na kanda za sauti katika kusikiliza mijadala mbalimbali.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotumia mitindo anuwai kuwashawishi wenzake katika mjadala kuhusu suala lengwa.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapochangia mjadala ipasavyo.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu zamu ya wengine katika mazungumzo.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapovitunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia katika kusikiliza au kutazama mjadala.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mjadala kuhusu suala lengwa.
Elimu ya afya ya kujikinga: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mjadala kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya kusikiliza na kujibizana aliyojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la usafi wa mazingira na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Integrated Science na Agriculture.

outcomes.text: kutambua vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusikiliza mjadala

skills.name: Sikiliza na uchangie mjadala ipasavyo
skills.mastery: Names the features to keep in this kind of talk (mjadala), picks the better of two ways to listen or reply in a situation on kupiga marufuku mifuko ya plastiki, and takes part in one in standard Kiswahili, judged by the teacher with the KICD rubric; in the app, 8 of 10 new items right.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 8 listening and replying in interviews.

misconceptions.error: States a side with no reason or example.

example.question: Katika mjadala kuhusu kupiga marufuku mifuko ya plastiki, ni mchango upi bora?

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks agreeing is contributing.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika mjadala kuhusu kupiga marufuku mifuko ya plastiki, ni mchango upi bora?" with "Nakubali." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Point-reason-example frame for every contribution.
misconceptions.feedback: Toa hoja, sababu na mfano.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Attacks the speaker, not the point (Wewe hujui chochote).

example.question: Hukubaliani na hoja ya mwenzako. Unasemaje?

misconceptions.cause: Disagreeing feels personal.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Hukubaliani na hoja ya mwenzako. Unasemaje?" with "Wewe hujui unachosema!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Model "Naheshimu..., lakini..."; ban personal words.
misconceptions.feedback: Pinga hoja kwa heshima, si mtu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Interrupts the speaker before he finishes.

example.question: Mwenzako bado anazungumza na una jambo la kusema. Ufanye nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child fears losing his idea.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwenzako bado anazungumza na una jambo la kusema. Ufanye nini?" with "mkatize ili usisahau" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Note the idea on paper; wait for the pause.
misconceptions.feedback: Msikilize mzungumzaji hadi amalize.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Answers or speaks on something other than the topic (kupiga marufuku mifuko ya plastiki).

example.question: Mada ni kupiga marufuku mifuko ya plastiki. Ni mchango upi unafaa?
example.correct_answer: Tunaweza kuchangia kupiga marufuku mifuko ya plastiki kwa njia hii...

misconceptions.cause: The child says what is on his mind.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mada ni kupiga marufuku mifuko ya plastiki. Ni mchango upi unafaa?" with "Jana nilitazama filamu nzuri sana." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Repeat the topic before speaking; link your point to it in the first sentence.
misconceptions.feedback: Changia kuhusu mada inayojadiliwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Theme 1: Usafi wa mazingira)
learning_experiences: kutambua habari mahususi katika kifungu cha simulizi kuhusu suala lengwa,
kudondoa habari mahususi katika kifungu cha simulizi,
kupanga matukio yanavyofuatana katika kifungu cha simulizi,
kutabiri matukio katika kifungu cha simulizi kutokana na picha au matukio,
kufasiri habari kutokana na kifungu cha simulizi,
kueleza maana ya maneno au msamiati kulingana na matumizi yake kimuktadha,
kutunga sentensi akitumia msamiati wa suala lengwa kwa usahihi na kuwasomea wenzake au kuwatumia mtandaoni ili wazitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Unafanya nini ili kupata habari zilizo katika kifungu cha simulizi kwa usahihi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapochangia kikamilifu na kushirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji kuhusu usomaji wa kifungu cha simulizi.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoweza kutumia msamiati wa suala lengwa ipasavyo kutunga sentensi sahihi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi akitumia msamiati wa suala lengwa.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapokubaliana na maoni ya wenzake na kushirikiana nao katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani na katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kutunza kifaa cha kidijitali.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anaposoma matini kuhusu suala lengwa.
Elimu ya afya ya kujikinga: mwanafunzi anaposoma matini kuhusu suala lengwa na kuzingatia ujumbe.

misconceptions.error: Answers a "why" question with a "what" (an event, not its reason).

example.question: Kwa nini mhusika alikimbia nyumbani?
example.correct_answer: kwa sababu aliogopa mbwa wa jirani

misconceptions.cause: The child finds the sentence with the words of the question and copies the event.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kwa nini mhusika alikimbia nyumbani?" with "alikimbia nyumbani" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the question word: nini, nani, wapi, lini, kwa nini; the answer must fit it.
misconceptions.feedback: Swali la "kwa nini" hujibiwa kwa sababu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Orders the events as they are told in the question or the options, not as they happen in the passage.

example.question: Ni tukio lipi lilitokea kwanza katika kifungu?

misconceptions.cause: The order of the options is taken for the order of the story.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni tukio lipi lilitokea kwanza katika kifungu?" with "tukio lililotajwa kwanza katika swali" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Number the events in the margin of the passage before looking at the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Fuata mpangilio wa matukio katika kifungu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Predicts with no clue from the passage, from what he wishes would happen.

example.question: Kutokana na kifungu, nini kitatokea baadaye?
example.correct_answer: jibu linalotokana na vidokezo vya kifungu

misconceptions.cause: Prediction is taken as imagination.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kutokana na kifungu, nini kitatokea baadaye?" with "mhusika atakuwa tajiri sana" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Every prediction needs a clue: "kwa sababu kifungu kinasema..."
misconceptions.feedback: Utabiri hutokana na vidokezo vya kifungu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the meaning of a look-alike word, or the everyday meaning where the passage means another.

example.question: Katika kifungu, neno "kupiga" katika "alipiga simu" lina maana gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child knows one meaning and does not test it against the sentence.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika kifungu, neno "kupiga" katika "alipiga simu" lina maana gani?" with "kumpiga mtu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Put each meaning into the sentence; keep the one that fits.
misconceptions.feedback: Maana ya neno hutegemea sentensi lilimo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Viakifishi (Theme 1: Usafi wa mazingira)
learning_experiences: kutambua alama ya koloni na semi koloni katika sentensi au vifungu kwenye matini andishi au za kidijitali,
kueleza matumizi ya koloni na semi koloni katika matini,
kusahihisha kifungu ambacho hakijatumia alama ya koloni na semi koloni ipasavyo,
kuandika daftarini mwake au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali, sentensi au kifungu kifupi kuhusu suala lengwa na masuala mengine kwa kutumia alama ya koloni na semi koloni ipasavyo,
kuwasomea wenzake kazi yake au kuwasambazia kwenye mtandao ili waitolee maoni,
kumweleza mzazi au mlezi wake kuhusu sentensi au vifungu alivyoandika vilivyo na matumizi mbalimbali ya alama za koloni na semi koloni.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, alama ya koloni hutumiwa wapi katika maandishi?
Je, alama ya semi koloni hutumiwa vipi katika maandishi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na wenzake katika kusahihisha vifungu walivyoandika.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kuandika kifungu na kukisambaza mtandaoni.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika vifungu vyenye matumizi yafaayo ya alama za koloni na semi koloni.
sub_strands.values:
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani na katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anapoandika kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.
Elimu ya afya ya kujikinga: mwanafunzi anapoandika kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.

misconceptions.error: Uses a comma where two full sentences on one idea are joined (semi koloni), or a semi koloni before a list (koloni).

example.question: Ni ipi imeandikwa sawa?

example.correct_answer: Tulifika mapema; walimu walikuwa bado hawajafika.

misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ipi imeandikwa sawa?" with "Tulifika mapema, walimu walikuwa bado hawajafika." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Koloni (:) introduces a list or an explanation; semi koloni (;) joins two complete, linked sentences.
misconceptions.feedback: Semi koloni huunganisha sentensi mbili kamili zinazohusiana.

skills.name: Tofautisha sauti /b/ na /mb/ katika silabi, maneno na vitanzandimi
skills.mastery: Hears, says and writes the right sound in syllables and words with /b/ na /mb/ (bali and mbali, bega and mbega), picks the word that matches the meaning, and tells a real kitanzandimi from an ordinary sentence, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 7 d/nd: the same nasal before a sound.

misconceptions.error: Hears or says /mb/ for /b/, so bali (but) becomes mbali (far).

example.question: Mwalimu anasema: "bali". Umesikia neno lipi?

misconceptions.cause: The nasal (n- or m-) before b is soft and quick; a child who does not hear it writes and says the word without it, or adds it where it does not belong, and the meaning changes.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema: "bali". Umesikia neno lipi?" with "mbali" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Say the pair slowly with a hand on the throat (or watching the lips); the child says which word was heard before writing.
misconceptions.feedback: Sikiliza tena: "bali" ina sauti /b/. "mbali" ni neno lingine lenye maana nyingine.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the word with the letter of the other sound (mbega where bega is meant).

example.question: Jaza pengo: ___ maana yake ni "a shoulder".

misconceptions.cause: The child spells as he speaks; if the two sounds are one sound in his speech, the letter is a guess.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza pengo: ___ maana yake ni "a shoulder"." with "mbega" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Pair each spelling with its meaning on a card; the child sorts the cards by meaning, then by letter.
misconceptions.feedback: Neno lenye maana ya "a shoulder" ni "bega". "mbega" lina maana ya "a colobus monkey".
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Thinks the two words are one word said in two ways, with one meaning.

example.question: "bega" na "mbega" ni maneno yenye maana moja?

misconceptions.cause: The child has heard both said by different people for the same thing and takes the difference for an accent.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""bega" na "mbega" ni maneno yenye maana moja?" with "ndiyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Use both words in two sentences that cannot swap: the child says which sentence breaks.
misconceptions.feedback: Hapana. "bega" ni a shoulder, na "mbega" ni a colobus monkey.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes any long sentence for a kitanzandimi, though it does not repeat the target sounds.

example.question: Ni kipi ni kitanzandimi?
example.correct_answer: Mbega mbele ya mbuzi alibeba mbegu mbili mbichi mbugani.

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks a kitanzandimi is any sentence that is hard to say, not one built by repeating close sounds.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kipi ni kitanzandimi?" with "Mazoezi ya asubuhi huimarisha mwili." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the target sounds in the real kitanzandimi; count them; the ordinary sentence has few or none.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitanzandimi hurudia sauti zinazokaribiana, kama /b/ na /mb/, ili kiwe kigumu kutamka.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Splits the syllable with the nasal wrongly (m-bali instead of keeping the nasal with its consonant).

example.question: Neno "mbali" lina silabi zipi?

misconceptions.cause: In Kiswahili every syllable ends in a vowel, and a nasal with its consonant (nd, mb, nj, ng) starts one syllable; the child splits by letters, not by sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "mbali" lina silabi zipi?" with "m-bali" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap the word: one clap per vowel; the nasal goes with the consonant after it.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: mba-li.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.feedback: Tarehe huandikwa chini ya anwani ya mwandishi, juu upande wa kulia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Ends with "Wako mtiifu" and a full name and title, as in an official letter.

example.question: Ni hitimisho lipi linafaa katika barua kwa rafiki?

misconceptions.cause: Again the official model is the only one the child has copied.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni hitimisho lipi linafaa katika barua kwa rafiki?" with "Wako mtiifu, Bw. Juma Hamisi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Collect three friendly closings and keep them in the exercise book.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua ya kirafiki humalizika kwa "Ni mimi rafiki yako," na jina la kwanza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes his own news and does not answer the questions or the points in the letter received.

example.question: Rafiki aliuliza kuhusu mazoezi unayofanya. Jibu lako lianze vipi baada ya salamu?
example.correct_answer: Asante kwa barua yako. Umeuliza kuhusu mazoezi yangu; ninakimbia kila asubuhi...

misconceptions.cause: The child treats the reply as a new letter.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Rafiki aliuliza kuhusu mazoezi unayofanya. Jibu lako lianze vipi baada ya salamu?" with "Nataka kukueleza kuhusu sherehe yetu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: List the questions in the letter received; tick each as you answer it.
misconceptions.feedback: Jibu la barua hujibu maswali na hoja za barua iliyopokelewa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Vihusishi (Theme 2: Mazoezi ya viungo vya mwili)
learning_experiences: kutambua vihusishi vya -a unganifu na vya sababu kutoka kwa kapu maneno, mti maneno, chati au katika tarakilishi,
kutambua vihusishi vya -a unganifu na vya sababu katika sentensi au vifungu kwenye vitabu au tarakilishi kwa kuzipigia mstari au kuzikolezea wino,
kutunga sentensi au vifungu vifupi kwa kutumia vihusishi vya -a unganifu na vya sababu akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la mazoezi ya viungo vya mwili,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi wake sentensi au vifungu alivyotunga ili amtolee maoni.

Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi kuhusu suala lengwa akitumia vihusishi vya -a unganifu na vya sababu.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomtajia mzazi au mlezi wake vihusishi vya -a unganifu na vya sababu katika mazingira ya nyumbani.

skills.name: Tambua vihusishi vya -a unganifu na vya sababu
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua kihusishi cha -a unganifu (cha, wa, ya: kitabu cha mwalimu) na cha sababu (kwa sababu ya, kwa ajili ya, kutokana na). Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Mixes the -a unganifu with the cause word.

example.question: Ni kihusishi kipi cha -a unganifu?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "kwa sababu ya" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Cha ni kihusishi cha -a unganifu.
misconceptions.feedback: Cha ni kihusishi cha -a unganifu.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Mixes the cause word with the -a unganifu.

example.question: Ni kihusishi kipi cha sababu?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "cha" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kwa sababu ya ni kihusishi cha sababu.
misconceptions.feedback: Kwa sababu ya ni kihusishi cha sababu.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Wrong agreement of -a unganifu.

example.question: Kamilisha: kitabu ___ mwalimu.

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "wa" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kitabu hupatana na cha.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitabu hupatana na cha.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Uses the -a of agreement of another class (Mazoezi ya mwili ni muhimu is right; the child writes mazoezi wa mwili, viungo ya mwili).

example.question: Jaza: viungo ___ mwili

misconceptions.cause: Ya is the commonest form and the child uses it everywhere.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: viungo ___ mwili" with "ya" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Find the first noun and its class: viungo (KI-VI) -> vya.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiunganishi -a hupatana na nomino ya kwanza: viungo vya mwili.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

kutambua tashbihi, sitiari na methali kutoka kwenye tungo simulizi, kapu la semi, au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusakura matumizi ya tashbihi, sitiari na methali katika tungo za fasihi simulizi,
kujadili na mwenzake matumizi ya tashbihi, sitiari na methali alizotafiti mtandaoni,
kushiriki katika uwasilishaji wa tashbihi, sitiari na methali,
kujadiliana na mzazi au mlezi wake kuhusu tashbihi, sitiari na methali katika jamii yake.
key_inquiry_questions: Tunatumia mbinu gani za lugha katika kuwasilisha tungo za fasihi simulizi?
Kwa nini tunatumia tashbihi, sitiari na methali kuwasilisha tungo za fasihi simulizi?

Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji kuhusu tashbihi, sitiari na methali.

Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na mzazi wake kuhusu tashbihi, sitiari na methali katika jamii yake.
Uraia: mwanafunzi anapojifunza kuhusu tashbihi, sitiari na methali za jamii yake na kuzithamini.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kusikiliza tashbihi, sitiari na methali na kuzichanganua.

kutambua tashbihi, sitiari na methali katika matini ya fasihi simulizi

skills.name: Eleza maana, aina na sifa za semi
skills.mastery: Explains the maana of semi (tashbihi, sitiari) with the right terms and examples, gives evidence or a reason for each point, and presents one with its formula, voice, gestures and audience part (presentation scored by the teacher), in 8 of 10 new items.

misconceptions.error: Mixes the two kinds (tashbihi and sitiari) and their purposes.

example.question: "Mkulima huyu ni simba wa shamba" ni semi ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: Both are semi; the child has not fixed what each is for and when it is used.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""Mkulima huyu ni simba wa shamba" ni semi ya aina gani?" with "sitiari" among the options.
misconceptions.help: List for each kind: who uses it, when, and why; sort examples.
misconceptions.feedback: "Mkulima huyu ni simba wa shamba" ni tashbihi: mkulima ana nguvu na ujasiri mkubwa kazini.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Calls semi written literature because it is found in a textbook.

example.question: Semi ni utanzu wa fasihi ipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child meets it on the page in class.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Semi ni utanzu wa fasihi ipi?" with "fasihi andishi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: who first made it, and how was it passed on? By mouth, from one generation to the next.
misconceptions.feedback: Semi ni fasihi simulizi: hupokezwa kwa mdomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Places the semi in the wrong occasion (a lullaby at a work party, a work song at a funeral).

example.question: Tashbihi hutumika lini?
example.correct_answer: kusifu au kukosoa tabia katika mazungumzo na hadithi

misconceptions.cause: The occasion is not stated in the text, and the child does not link form to use.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tashbihi hutumika lini?" with "wakati wowote" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act out the occasion; which kind fits it?
misconceptions.feedback: Tashbihi hutumika kusifu au kukosoa tabia katika mazungumzo na hadithi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a line of the text as its message instead of the lesson.

example.question: Ujumbe wa "Mkulima huyu ni simba wa shamba" ni upi?
example.wrong_answer: Mkulima huyu ni simba wa shamba
example.correct_answer: mkulima ana nguvu na ujasiri mkubwa kazini.

misconceptions.cause: Copying a line feels like a safe answer.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa "Mkulima huyu ni simba wa shamba" ni upi?" with "Mkulima huyu ni simba wa shamba" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Close the text; say the lesson in your own words.
misconceptions.feedback: Ujumbe ni funzo kwa maneno yako mwenyewe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 3: Utunzaji wa wanyama)

kusoma mashairi katika diwani iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu na kueleza sifa za ushairi katika mashairi hayo,
kuwasomea wenzake sifa alizotambua katika mashairi aliyoyasoma ili wamtolee maoni.

Unavutiwa na nini unaposoma shairi?

Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapowasomea wenzake sifa za shairi alilosoma.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anaposakura mtandaoni shairi na kuchambua sifa zake.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anaposoma shairi na kuchambua sifa zake.

Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya shairi ili kulitofautisha na tungo nyingine
kujadili sifa za ushairi kama utanzu wa fasihi andishi
kueleza sifa za ushairi katika shairi

skills.name: Eleza maana na sifa za shairi
skills.mastery: Explains the utanzu of a shairi read in class ("Sauti ya Mama Dunia") with a correct term, gives evidence from the text for every point, and says why it matters to the work, in 8 of 10 new items (longer written answers marked by the teacher).

prerequisites.reason: Grade 6 kinds of poems by lines.

misconceptions.error: Takes a shairi for another kind of text (wimbo) or gives the features of the other kind.

example.question: Ni sifa ipi ni ya shairi?
example.wrong_answer: huandikwa kwa aya ndefu bila mpangilio
example.correct_answer: huwa na beti, mishororo, vina na mizani

misconceptions.cause: The child has met several kinds of literature and keeps one list of features for all of them.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sifa ipi ni ya shairi?" with "huandikwa kwa aya ndefu bila mpangilio" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Lay a shairi and a wimbo side by side and list what only the shairi has.
misconceptions.feedback: Shairi lina beti, mishororo, vina na mizani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Calls a shairi oral literature (fasihi simulizi) because it can be read aloud or acted.

example.question: Shairi ni utanzu wa fasihi ipi?

misconceptions.cause: Plays are acted and poems are recited, so the child thinks of them as spoken.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Shairi ni utanzu wa fasihi ipi?" with "fasihi simulizi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: was it first composed in writing by a known author? Then it is fasihi andishi, even when performed.
misconceptions.feedback: Shairi ni fasihi andishi: imeandikwa na mwandishi anayejulikana.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives one feature only (length, or rhyme) as the whole meaning of a shairi.

example.question: Eleza maana ya shairi.
example.correct_answer: ni utungo wa kisanaa wenye mpangilio wa beti, mishororo, vina na mizani unaowasilisha ujumbe

misconceptions.cause: The child remembers the most visible feature.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Eleza maana ya shairi." with "ni maneno yenye vina" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Build the definition from three parts: what kind of text, its form, its purpose.
misconceptions.feedback: Maana kamili ya shairi hutaja aina yake, muundo wake na lengo lake.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes the narrator or a character for the author of the shairi.

example.question: Ni nani mwandishi wa "Sauti ya Mama Dunia"?

misconceptions.cause: The narrator speaks as "I" and the child takes that voice for the writer.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni nani mwandishi wa "Sauti ya Mama Dunia"?" with "Mama Dunia (nafsineni)" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Find the author's name on the cover; the narrator and characters are inside the story.
misconceptions.feedback: Mwandishi ni mtunzi; msimulizi na wahusika ni sehemu ya kazi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Kubuni (Theme 3: Utunzaji wa wanyama)

Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya masimulizi akizingatia ufafanuzi ufaao wa ujumbe kupitia kwa wahusika.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuandika insha na kuwasomea wenzake.

Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.

outcomes.text: kutambua vipengele vya kufafanulia ujumbe wa insha ya masimulizi
kufafanua ujumbe wa insha ya masimulizi kupitia kwa utangulizi, kiini na hitimisho
kufafanua ujumbe wa insha ya masimulizi kupitia kwa wahusika
kuandika insha ya masimulizi kwa kuzingatia ujumbe na muundo ufaao

skills.name: Fafanua ujumbe wa insha ya masimulizi kupitia muundo na wahusika
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya kubuni from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a creative story built paragraph by paragraph, with characters, a setting and vivid language; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 8 developed an idea in each paragraph.

misconceptions.error: Writes the whole insha as one paragraph with no utangulizi, kiini and hitimisho.

example.question: Insha "Mbwa Aliyeokoa Familia" ina sehemu zipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child writes until the space is full and has not planned the parts.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Insha "Mbwa Aliyeokoa Familia" ina sehemu zipi?" with "aya moja ndefu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Fold the page into three; one part in each; one idea per paragraph in the middle.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ina utangulizi, kiini chenye aya kadhaa, na hitimisho.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the characters no names, no features and no words of their own, so the reader cannot see them.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inamjenga mhusika vizuri katika insha "Mbwa Aliyeokoa Familia"?
example.correct_answer: Mzee Juma, mwenye ndevu nyeupe na fimbo ya mpingo, alisimama mlangoni.

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks of the events, not the people in them.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inamjenga mhusika vizuri katika insha "Mbwa Aliyeokoa Familia"?" with "Mtu mmoja alikuja." among the options.
misconceptions.help: For each character: a name, one look, one trait shown by an action.
misconceptions.feedback: Wape wahusika majina, sura na tabia zinazoonekana kwa matendo yao.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Ends the insha abruptly ("Mwisho." or "The end") with no closing paragraph (hitimisho).

example.question: Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Mbwa Aliyeokoa Familia"?
example.correct_answer: Tangu siku hiyo, nimejifunza mengi kuhusu jambo hili.

misconceptions.cause: Storybooks for young readers end with "Mwisho" and the child copies that.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Mbwa Aliyeokoa Familia"?" with "Mwisho." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show three endings; the child picks the one that closes the main idea or the lesson.
misconceptions.feedback: Hitimisho hufunga insha kwa kueleza funzo au hisia, si kwa neno "Mwisho" tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya kubuni yenye anwani "Mbwa Aliyeokoa Familia", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Mbwa Simba, mwenye macho ya kahawia, alisimama mlangoni akibweka bila kukoma.

misconceptions.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya kubuni yenye anwani "Mbwa Aliyeokoa Familia", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Vihusishi (Theme 3: Utunzaji wa wanyama)
learning_experiences: kuchopoa vihusishi vilinganishi na kihusishi na katika kapu maneno, mti maneno, chati au katika tarakilishi,
kutambua vihusishi vilinganishi na kihusishi na katika sentensi au vifungu kwenye vitabu au tarakilishi kwa kuzipigia mstari au kuzikolezea wino,
kutunga sentensi au vifungu kwa kutumia vihusishi vilinganishi na kihusishi na akizingatia suala lengwa na masuala mtambuko mbalimbali,
kumtajia mzazi au mlezi wake kihusishi na na vihusishi vilinganishi katika mazingira ya nyumbani.
key_inquiry_questions: Vihusishi vilinganishi na kihusishi na huchangia vipi katika mawasiliano?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji kuhusu aina za vihusishi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutambua vihusishi vilinganishi na kihusishi na.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua vihusishi vilinganishi na kihusishi na katika matini na kuvitungia sentensi sahihi na vifungu.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomtajia mzazi au mlezi wake vihusishi vilinganishi na kihusishi na katika mazingira ya nyumbani.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani na katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Elimu ya utunzaji wa wanyama: mwanafunzi anapoandika sentensi au kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya vihusishi katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la utunzaji wa wanyama na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Agriculture.

outcomes.text: kutambua vihusishi vilinganishi na kihusishi na katika matini
kutumia vihusishi vilinganishi na kihusishi na ipasavyo katika matini
kuchangamkia kutumia vihusishi vilinganishi na kihusishi na katika mawasiliano ya kila siku

skills.name: Tambua vihusishi vilinganishi na kihusishi na
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua vihusishi vilinganishi (kuliko, kama, mithili ya) na kihusishi na kinachoonyesha pamoja (pamoja na). Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Does not know kuliko.

example.question: Ni kihusishi kipi kinalinganisha?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "pamoja na" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kuliko hulinganisha.
misconceptions.feedback: Kuliko hulinganisha.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Does not know na as togetherness.

example.question: Katika "Alikuja na rafiki yake", na inaonyesha nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "ulinganisho" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Na hapa inaonyesha pamoja.
misconceptions.feedback: Na hapa inaonyesha pamoja.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Mixes kama with sababu.

example.question: Ni kihusishi kipi kinalinganisha vitu viwili?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "kwa ajili ya" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kama hulinganisha vitu viwili.
misconceptions.feedback: Kama hulinganisha vitu viwili.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Uses "zaidi ya" and "kuliko" together (mkubwa zaidi kuliko zaidi ya), or "kama" for comparing degrees.

example.question: Jaza: Tembo ni mkubwa ___ kiboko.

misconceptions.cause: English "than" and "as" are mixed.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Tembo ni mkubwa ___ kiboko." with "kama" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Kuliko / zaidi ya for more; kama / sawa na for equal.
misconceptions.feedback: Tunalinganisha kwa kuliko au zaidi ya: mkubwa kuliko kiboko.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Semi (Theme 4: Utunzaji wa maliasili)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya vitendawili,
kueleza maana ya nahau,
kutambua vitendawili na nahau mbalimbali katika matini ya fasihi simulizi na kueleza maana zake,
kutafiti mtandaoni au maktabani umuhimu wa vitendawili na nahau,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi kwa kutumia nahau mwafaka,
kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia nahau ipasavyo,
kujadili vipengele vya uwasilishaji wa vitendawili akiwa na wenzake,
kuwawasilishia wenzake vitendawili kwa kuzingatia vipengele vya uwasilishaji wa vitendawili,
kushirikiana na mzazi au mlezi wake kutambua vitendawili na nahau katika jamii yake.
key_inquiry_questions: Unazingatia nini unapowasilisha vitendawili?
Kwa nini tunatumia nahau katika mawasiliano?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na wenzake katika kuwasilisha vitendawili mbalimbali.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutafiti kuhusu vitendawili na nahau.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapotega na kutegua vitendawili, anapotoa maana za nahau na kuchangia katika kikundi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na mzazi au mlezi wake kutambua vitendawili na nahau kutoka kwa jamii yake.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika majadiliano ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika kuwasilisha vitendawili na nahau katika kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kutega na kutegua vitendawili na wenzake kuhusu suala la maliasili katika mazingira yake.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana za vitendawili na nahau katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hizo katika somo la English.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya vitendawili na nahau ili kuipambanua
kutambua vitendawili na nahau katika matini
kufafanua umuhimu wa vitendawili na nahau katika fasihi simulizi
kutumia nahau ipasavyo katika mawasiliano
kuwasilisha vitendawili kwa kuzingatia vipengele vya uwasilishaji wake
kuchangamkia matumizi ya nahau na uwasilishaji wa vitendawili katika tungo za fasihi

skills.name: Wasilisha semi kwa kuzingatia vipengele vya uwasilishaji
skills.mastery: Explains the uwasilishaji of semi (vitendawili, nahau) with the right terms and examples, gives evidence or a reason for each point, and presents one with its formula, voice, gestures and audience part (presentation scored by the teacher), in 8 of 10 new items.

misconceptions.error: Starts or ends without the opening or closing formula (Kitendawili!).

example.question: Msimulizi anaanzaje?
example.wrong_answer: anaanza moja kwa moja na kisa

misconceptions.cause: Telling has been practised as reading a text aloud.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Msimulizi anaanzaje?" with "anaanza moja kwa moja na kisa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Practise the formula with the class answering.
misconceptions.feedback: Anza kwa fomula: "Kitendawili!" - "Tega!"
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Presents in one flat voice, with no change for characters or feelings.

example.question: Unapowasilisha, sauti yako iweje?
example.correct_answer: ibadilike kulingana na mhusika na hisia

misconceptions.cause: The child is shy and keeps the voice safe.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unapowasilisha, sauti yako iweje?" with "moja tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Give each character a voice; rehearse one line in each.
misconceptions.feedback: Badilisha sauti kulingana na mhusika na hisia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses no gestures, or gestures that do not match the words.

example.question: Ni ishara ipi inafaa unapotaja "mlima mrefu"?

misconceptions.cause: The body is forgotten under the stress of remembering words.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ishara ipi inafaa unapotaja "mlima mrefu"?" with "kushika kichwa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Mirror pairs: one says, one shows; swap.
misconceptions.feedback: Ishara ziendane na maneno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Presents to the floor or the teacher only, with no eye contact and no call for responses.

example.question: Unawasilisha mbele ya darasa. Unawaangalia nani?

misconceptions.cause: Reciting for marks is done to the teacher.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unawasilisha mbele ya darasa. Unawaangalia nani?" with "chini au mwalimu peke yake" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Divide the room into three; look at each part in turn.
misconceptions.feedback: Iangalie na uishirikishe hadhira yote.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Ufasaha (Theme 4: Utunzaji wa maliasili)
learning_experiences: kutambua vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusoma kwa ufasaha,
kusoma kifungu cha nathari akizingatia matamshi bora,
kusoma kifungu cha nathari akizingatia kasi ifaayo (maneno sahihi yasiyopungua 110 kwa dakika),
kusoma kifungu cha nathari akizingatia kiwango kifaacho cha sauti,
kusoma kifungu cha nathari akizingatia ishara za mwili zifaazo,
kusakura kifungu cha nathari mtandaoni na kuwasomea wenzake kwa ufasaha,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi wake kifungu cha nathari kwa ufasaha ili amtolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unaposoma kifungu chochote unazingatia mambo gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake katika kusoma kwa ufasaha.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kwa kuzingatia vipengele vifaavyo vya usomaji.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusakura kifungu cha nathari.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu wenzake wakisoma kifungu.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake kujadili vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusoma kwa ufasaha.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa hasa kuhusu suala la maliasili katika mazingira yake.
Elimu ya kifedha: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa na kuwazia kuhusu matumizi ya maliasili.
Umaskini: mwanafunzi anapowazia jinsi matumizi yafaayo ya maliasili yanawezesha kupunguza umaskini.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha kusoma kwa ufasaha katika somo la Kiswahili na usomaji huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la utunzaji wa maliasili na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Agriculture.

outcomes.text: kutambua vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusoma kwa ufasaha
kusoma kifungu cha nathari akizingatia matamshi bora
kusoma kifungu cha nathari akizingatia kasi ifaayo
kusoma kifungu cha nathari akizingatia kiwango kifaacho cha sauti
kusoma kifungu cha nathari akizingatia ishara za mwili zifaazo
kujenga mazoea ya kusoma kwa ufasaha ili kufanikisha mawasiliano

skills.name: Soma kifungu kwa sauti kwa matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo, sauti ifaayo na ishara
skills.mastery: Reads a short passage aloud at a speaking pace, pauses at the koma and the kikomo, raises the voice for a question and shows feeling for an exclamation, says every sound clearly (no l for r), and uses a matching gesture, judged by the teacher with the KICD rubric; in the app picks the better reading of a line in 8 of 10 new items.

misconceptions.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Jamii ilikubaliana kulinda chemchemi ya maji kwa kupanda miti kando yake."?
example.wrong_answer: Jamii ... ilikubaliana ... kulinda ... chemchemi ... ya ... maji ... kwa ... kupanda ... miti ... kando ... yake.
example.correct_answer: Jamii ilikubaliana kulinda chemchemi ya maji kwa kupanda miti kando yake.

misconceptions.cause: The child is still decoding each word and has not yet learnt to read a phrase as one piece.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Jamii ilikubaliana kulinda chemchemi ya maji kwa kupanda miti kando yake."?" with "Jamii ... ilikubaliana ... kulinda ... chemchemi ... ya ... maji ... kwa ... kupanda ... miti ... kando ... yake." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it as one breath; then phrase-cut the passage with slashes.
misconceptions.feedback: Usomaji wa ufasaha husoma kundi la maneno kwa pamoja, kama tunavyozungumza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, ili kila neno lisikike

misconceptions.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; the child has not been asked whether listeners understood.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Time two readings: one very fast, one at speaking pace; listeners answer one question after each.
misconceptions.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ile ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads a question and an exclamation in the same flat voice as a statement.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, vizazi vijavyo vitapata maji safi?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

misconceptions.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the mark at the end.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, vizazi vijavyo vitapata maji safi?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that matches each reading.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; alama ya hisi (!) huonyesha hisia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads on through the koma and the kikomo without a pause.

example.question: Unasoma: "Ole wetu tusipotunza misitu!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?
example.wrong_answer: hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja
example.correct_answer: kwenye koma na kwenye kikomo au alama ya hisi

misconceptions.cause: The marks are read as decoration; the child has not linked them to breath.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unasoma: "Ole wetu tusipotunza misitu!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?" with "hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap once at a koma, twice at a kikomo while reading together.
misconceptions.feedback: Simama kidogo kwenye koma, na zaidi kwenye kikomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Says /l/ for /r/ or /r/ for /l/ while reading (kulinda read as kurinda).

example.question: Neno "kulinda" linatamkwa vipi?

misconceptions.cause: The first language of the child does not separate these sounds, so the reading carries the home sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "kulinda" linatamkwa vipi?" with "kurinda" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Make a list of the passage words with the hard sound; practise them before reading the passage.
misconceptions.feedback: Tamka "kulinda" kama lilivyoandikwa; "kurinda" ni neno jingine au si neno.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Kubuni (Theme 4: Utunzaji wa maliasili)
learning_experiences: kutambua vipengele vya lugha ya kitamathali, matendo ya wahusika na mandhari katika masimulizi kwenye matini andishi au za kidijitali,
kusoma vielelezo vya insha ya kubuni kwenye matini za kimaandishi au za kidijitali na kubainisha lugha ya kitamathali, matendo ya wahusika na mandhari,
kuandika insha ya masimulizi kuhusu suala lengwa akitumia vipengele vifaavyo vya lugha ya kitamathali, matendo ya wahusika na mandhari ili kujenga taswira zifaazo,
kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika kuhusu suala lengwa ili wachanganue lugha ya kitamathali, matendo ya wahusika na mandhari.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unazingatia vipengele vipi unapoandika insha ya masimulizi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na wenzake katika kuchanganua lugha ya kitamathali, matendo ya wahusika na uchoraji wa mandhari katika insha.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha kwa kuzingatia lugha ya kitamathali, matendo ya wahusika na uchoraji wa mandhari ufaao.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapowasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika na kuwataka wachanganue lugha ya kitamathali, matendo ya wahusika na uchoraji wa mandhari.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani na katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha kuhusu suala lengwa hasa kuhusu suala la maliasili katika mazingira yake.
Elimu ya kifedha: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha kuhusu suala lengwa na kuwazia kuhusu matumizi ya maliasili.
Umaskini: mwanafunzi anapowazia jinsi matumizi yafaayo ya maliasili yanawezesha kupunguza umaskini.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha uandishi wa insha ya masimulizi katika somo la Kiswahili na uandishi huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la utunzaji wa maliasili na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Agriculture.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya lugha ya kitamathali, matendo ya wahusika na mandhari ili kuibanisha
kujadili lugha ya kitamathali, matendo ya wahusika na mandhari katika insha ya masimulizi
kuandika insha ya masimulizi akizingatia lugha ya kitamathali, matendo ya wahusika na mandhari
kufurahia kuandika insha za masimulizi akizingatia lugha ya kitamathali, matendo ya wahusika na uchoraji wa mandhari ufaao ili kufanikisha mawasiliano

skills.name: Andika insha ya masimulizi kwa lugha ya kitamathali, matendo ya wahusika na mandhari
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya kubuni from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a creative story built paragraph by paragraph, with characters, a setting and vivid language; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Theme 3 message through structure and characters.
Grade 8 devices of language in a story.

misconceptions.error: Writes in plain, flat words with no language devices (tashbihi, sitiari, methali, nahau) to make the insha vivid.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ina lugha ya kiubunifu kwa insha "Chemchemi Iliyokauka"?
example.correct_answer: Chemchemi iliyokuwa ikicheka kwa sauti ya maji sasa ilinyamaza kama kaburi.

misconceptions.cause: The child has not been shown how devices from fasihi can be used in his own writing.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ina lugha ya kiubunifu kwa insha "Chemchemi Iliyokauka"?" with "Chemchemi ilikauka." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Collect three devices from a class reader; rewrite one plain sentence with each.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia tashbihi, sitiari, methali au nahau kufanya insha iwe hai.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the characters no names, no features and no words of their own, so the reader cannot see them.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inamjenga mhusika vizuri katika insha "Chemchemi Iliyokauka"?
example.correct_answer: Mzee Juma, mwenye ndevu nyeupe na fimbo ya mpingo, alisimama mlangoni.

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks of the events, not the people in them.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inamjenga mhusika vizuri katika insha "Chemchemi Iliyokauka"?" with "Mtu mmoja alikuja." among the options.
misconceptions.help: For each character: a name, one look, one trait shown by an action.
misconceptions.feedback: Wape wahusika majina, sura na tabia zinazoonekana kwa matendo yao.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives no setting (time and place) or one that does not fit the events.

example.question: Ni mwanzo upi unaonyesha mandhari ya insha "Chemchemi Iliyokauka"?
example.correct_answer: Ilikuwa jioni ya Ijumaa katika soko la Gikomba, watu wakiwa wamesongamana.

misconceptions.cause: The child starts with the action.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mwanzo upi unaonyesha mandhari ya insha "Chemchemi Iliyokauka"?" with "Kisa hiki kilitokea." among the options.

sub_strands.sub_strand: Vielezi (Theme 6: Usalama barabarani)
learning_experiences: kuchopoa vielezi vya namna na vya wakati kutoka kwenye chati, kadi maneno, kapu maneno au tarakilishi,
kuvipigia mstari vielezi vya namna na vya wakati katika sentensi na vifungu,
kutenga vielezi vya namna na vya wakati katika orodha ya maneno, sentensi au vifungu kwenye vitabu, tarakilishi, chati kwa kuvikolezea wino,
kutunga sentensi au vifungu vifupi kwa kutumia vielezi vya namna na vya wakati akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la usalama barabarani,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi wake sentensi alizotunga akitumia vielezi vya namna na vya wakati ili amtolee maoni.

Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi akitumia vielezi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomsomea mzazi au mlezi wake sentensi alizotunga.

Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusikiliza kwa Kutathmini (Theme 7: Huduma katika asasi za kijamii)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya kusikiliza kwa kutathmini ili kuubainisha,
kujadili na wenzake vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusikiliza kwa kutathmini kutoka kwenye mazungumzo mafupi,

kusikiliza mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa (k.v. Majukumu ya Mamlaka ya Uchukuzi na Usalama Barabarani, Kituo cha Huduma kwa Taifa,) kutoka kwa mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au katika vifaa vya kidijitali huku akijadili vipengele vya kusikiliza kwa kutathmini vilivyozingatiwa,
kutoa maoni kuhusu suala linaloshughulikiwa katika kauli au kifungu alichosikiliza,
kusikiliza matini kuhusu suala lengwa kutoka kwenye kinasa sauti au mgeni mwalikwa na kueleza maana ya msamiati ambao umetumiwa katika matini hiyo.
key_inquiry_questions: Unazingatia nini ili kupata ujumbe unaowasilishwa na mzungumzaji?

Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kujadili kuhusu vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusikiliza kwa kutathmini.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikilizia mazungumzo.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapotoa mtazamo wake kuhusu suala alilosikiliza. Pia anapofasiri maana kutokana na viziada lugha kama vile ishara za uso.

Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Masuala ya huduma kwa jamii: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli ya ujifunzaji wa kusikiliza kwa kutathmini kuhusu suala lengwa.

kutambua umuhimu wa lugha inayoathiri hisia kutokana na kifungu kwenye kitabu au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kuzingatia lugha inayoathiri hisia mbalimbali na kutekeleza majukumu ya kushawishi, kuburudisha, kupasha habari au kufunza.
