misconceptions.help: Collect three devices from a class reader; rewrite one plain sentence with each.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia tashbihi, sitiari, methali au nahau kufanya insha iwe hai.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses vague or repeated words (kitu, kizuri, sana sana) where an exact word is needed.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ina msamiati ufaao kuhusu "Siku Katika Kituo cha Watoto Yatima"?
example.correct_answer: Macho ya Amani, yaliyojaa matumaini, yalinitazama nilipomkabidhi kitabu kipya.

misconceptions.cause: The child writes as he talks and has a small store of exact words.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ina msamiati ufaao kuhusu "Siku Katika Kituo cha Watoto Yatima"?" with "Watoto walifurahi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Keep a theme word bank; replace every "kitu" and "kizuri" from it.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia neno mahususi badala ya maneno ya jumla.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Siku Katika Kituo cha Watoto Yatima"?
example.correct_answer: Macho ya Amani, yaliyojaa matumaini, yalinitazama nilipomkabidhi kitabu kipya.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Siku Katika Kituo cha Watoto Yatima"?" with "Watoto walifurahi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Vielezi (Theme 7: Huduma katika asasi za kijamii)
learning_experiences: kuchopoa vielezi vya mahali na vya idadi kwenye chati, kadi maneno, kapu maneno au tarakilishi,
kuvipigia mstari vielezi vya mahali na vya idadi katika sentensi na vifungu,
kutenga vielezi vya mahali na vya idadi katika orodha ya maneno, sentensi au vifungu kwenye vitabu, tarakilishi, chati kwa kuvikolezea wino au kuvipigia mstari,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi au vifungu kwa kutumia vielezi vya mahali na vya idadi,
kutunga sentensi au vifungu kwa kutumia vielezi vya mahali na vya idadi akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la huduma katika asasi za kijamii,
kuwasomea wenzake sentensi au vifungu alivyotunga ili watambue vielezi vya mahali na vya idadi,
key_inquiry_questions: Ni mahali gani panaweza kutajwa na vielezi vya mahali?
Ni idadi gani zinazoweza kutajwa na vielezi vya idadi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji kuhusu vielezi vya mahali na vya idadi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutambua vielezi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi kuhusu suala lengwa akitumia vielezi.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua vielezi na kuvitungia sentensi sahihi na vifungu.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomtajia mzazi au mlezi wake vielezi vinavyohusu shughuli katika mazingira ya nyumbani.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani na katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Masuala ya huduma kwa jamii: mwanafunzi anapoandika kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kutumia vielezi.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya vielezi vya mahali na vya idadi katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la huduma katika asasi za kijamii na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Religious Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua vielezi vya mahali na vya idadi katika matini
kutumia vielezi vya mahali na vya idadi ipasavyo katika matini
kuchangamkia kutumia vielezi vya mahali na vya idadi katika sentensi na vifungu

skills.name: Tambua vielezi vya mahali na vya idadi
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua vielezi vya mahali (hapa, pale, huku, kule, nyumbani, mjini) na vya idadi (mara mbili, kidogo, sana, mara nyingi). Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Place adverbs (hapa, kule, humu) follow PA-KU-MU.

misconceptions.error: Gives a number word for place.

example.question: Ni kielezi kipi cha mahali?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "mara mbili" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Pale ni kielezi cha mahali.
misconceptions.feedback: Pale ni kielezi cha mahali.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Gives a place word for number.

example.question: Ni kielezi kipi cha idadi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "huku" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Mara mbili ni kielezi cha idadi.
misconceptions.feedback: Mara mbili ni kielezi cha idadi.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Wrong question for the adverb.

example.question: Kielezi cha mahali hujibu swali gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Lini?" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kielezi cha mahali hujibu "wapi?".
misconceptions.feedback: Kielezi cha mahali hujibu "wapi?".
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Writes the adverb of number as a number adjective (mara mbili is right; the child writes mbili mara or wawili).

example.question: Jaza: Alikuja ___ (2).

misconceptions.cause: The number adjective is better known.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Alikuja ___ (2)." with "wawili" among the options.
misconceptions.help: How many times? mara + number: mara mbili, mara tatu.
misconceptions.feedback: Kielezi cha idadi: mara mbili.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Uzungumzaji wa Kushawishi (Theme 8: Misukosuko ya kijamii)
learning_experiences: kutafiti na kueleza maana ya uzungumzaji wa kushawishi,
kubainisha, miktadha katika jamii yake ambamo uzungumzaji wa kushawishi hutokea,
kushirikiana na wenzake kujadili vipengele vya kuzingatia katika uzungumzaji wa kushawishi,
kubuni mazungumzo mepesi kuhusu suala lengwa na kuwawasilishia wenzake wamtathmini iwapo ametumia vipengele vifaavyo vya uwasilishaji wa uzungumzaji wa kushawishi ,
kusikiliza uzungumzaji wa kushawishi kuhusu suala lengwa kutoka kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali au mgeni mwalikwa na kubainisha vipengele vya uzungumzaji wa kushawishi vilivyozingatiwa ,
kushirikiana na wenzake katika uzungumzaji wa kushawishi kuhusu suala lengwa huku akizingatia vipengele vya uwasilishaji wa uzungumzaji w a kushawishi.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni lini tunatumia mazungumzo ya kushawishi?
Utafanya nini ili mazungumzo yako yawe na ushawishi kwa wengine?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapojieleza kuhusu suala lengwa kwa njia wazi na kwa lugha inayomwaminisha msikilizaji kwamba anasema ukweli.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapobuni uzungumzaji wa kushawishi kuhusu suala lengwa na kuyawasilisha kwa mtindo ufaao.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kushawishi kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.values:
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake fursa ya kujieleza bila kuwakatiza au kushughulikia mengine wanapozungumza.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia katika kujifunza.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na wenzake na kutoa mchango katika shughuli za kikundi.
Amani: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na wengine katika mazungumzo ya kushawishi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa utulivu.
sub_strands.pcis: Suala la misukosuko ya kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki uzungumzaji wa kushawishi kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha uzungumzaji wa kushawishi katika somo la Kiswahili na uzungumzaji huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la misukosuko ya kijamii na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Religious Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya uzungumzaji wa kushawishi ili kuupambanua
kubainisha miktadha ya uzungumzaji wa kushawishi
kujadili vipengele vya kuzingatia katika uzungumzaji wa kushawishi
kufanya mazungumzo ya kushawishi akizingatia vipengele vya uzungumzaji wa kushawishi
kujenga mazoea ya kuwasilisha hoja kwa mazungumzo yanayoshawishi hadhira

skills.name: Zungumza kwa kushawishi
skills.mastery: Names the features to keep in this kind of talk (kushawishi), picks the better of two ways to listen or reply in a situation on kujiunga na klabu ya amani shuleni, and takes part in one in standard Kiswahili, judged by the teacher with the KICD rubric; in the app, 8 of 10 new items right.

prerequisites.reason: Theme 1 gave reasons in a debate.

misconceptions.error: Tries to persuade by repeating the demand, with no reasons or benefits.

example.question: Unawashawishi wenzako wajiunge na klabu ya mazingira. Ni lipi bora?
example.correct_answer: Jiungeni kwa sababu tutapanda miti, tutajifunza na tutashinda tuzo.

misconceptions.cause: Insisting feels like persuading.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unawashawishi wenzako wajiunge na klabu ya mazingira. Ni lipi bora?" with "Jiungeni! Jiungeni! Jiungeni!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Every claim gets a reason and a benefit for the listener.
misconceptions.feedback: Kushawishi kunahitaji sababu na faida kwa msikilizaji.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses threats or insults to persuade.

example.question: Ni lipi ni ushawishi unaofaa?

misconceptions.cause: Pressure works at the playground.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni lipi ni ushawishi unaofaa?" with "Msipojiunga mtaona!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Compare a threat and a benefit: which keeps the friend?
misconceptions.feedback: Shawishi kwa hoja na heshima, si vitisho.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses Sheng or English words in a formal talk.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika mazungumzo rasmi?

misconceptions.cause: The child talks as with friends.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika mazungumzo rasmi?" with "Ma-guys, hii issue ni serious." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Record and replay; replace each non-Kiswahili word.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia Kiswahili sanifu katika mazungumzo rasmi.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Answers or speaks on something other than the topic (kujiunga na klabu ya amani shuleni).

example.question: Mada ni kujiunga na klabu ya amani shuleni. Ni mchango upi unafaa?
example.correct_answer: Tunaweza kuchangia kujiunga na klabu ya amani shuleni kwa njia hii...

misconceptions.cause: The child says what is on his mind.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mada ni kujiunga na klabu ya amani shuleni. Ni mchango upi unafaa?" with "Jana nilitazama filamu nzuri sana." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Repeat the topic before speaking; link your point to it in the first sentence.
misconceptions.feedback: Changia kuhusu mada inayojadiliwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 8: Misukosuko ya kijamii)
learning_experiences: kutafiti mtandaoni au maktabani maana ya mandhari katika fasihi,
kujadiliana na wenzake matokeo ya utafiti wake,
kusoma mashairi mbalimbali ili kutambua mandhari mbalimbali katika shairi,
kueleza umuhimu wa mandhari katika shairi,
kufafanua vipengele vya muundo wa shairi ili kuipambanua,
kughani shairi ili kutambua mandhari na muundo katika shairi,
kusoma mashairi katika diwani ya mashairi iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu na kuyachambua kwa kuzingatia mandhari na muundo kisha awasilishe kazi yake kwa wenzake ili waitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, mashairi uliyosoma yana mandhari ya aina gani?
Vipengele vya muundo vinahusu nini?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapotambua na kujadili mandhari na muundo kwenye shairi akiwa na wenzake katika kikundi.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapochambua shairi na kubainisha mandhari na muundo wa shairi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapotafiti maktabani na mtandaoni kuhusu muundo na mandhari katika shairi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake wanapojadili kuhusu mandhari na muundo katika shairi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapotoa maoni kuhusu uwasilishaji wa wenzake ili kuwarekebisha au kuwahimiza.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki kukariri shairi kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.pcis: Suala la misukosuko ya kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposoma shairi kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya mandhari na muundo katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la misukosuko ya kijamii na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Religious Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya mandhari katika fasihi
kutambua mandhari mbalimbali katika shairi
kueleza umuhimu wa mandhari katika shairi
kufafanua vipengele vya muundo katika shairi
kuchambua shairi kwa kuzingatia mandhari na muundo
kuchangamkia nafasi ya mandhari na muundo katika shairi

skills.name: Eleza mandhari na ploti ya shairi
skills.mastery: Explains the mandhari of a shairi read in class ("Sauti ya Mama Dunia") with a correct term, gives evidence from the text for every point, and says why it matters to the work, in 8 of 10 new items (longer written answers marked by the teacher).

skills.name: Fafanua muundo wa shairi
skills.mastery: Explains the muundo of a shairi read in class ("Sauti ya Mama Dunia") with a correct term, gives evidence from the text for every point, and says why it matters to the work, in 8 of 10 new items (longer written answers marked by the teacher).

prerequisites.reason: The features of ushairi come first.

misconceptions.error: Gives only the place as mandhari, and leaves out the time and the social setting.

example.question: Mandhari ya "Sauti ya Mama Dunia" ni yapi?

misconceptions.cause: Mandhari is first taught as "mahali".
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mandhari ya "Sauti ya Mama Dunia" ni yapi?" with "msitu unaokatwa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Make three boxes: mahali, wakati, hali ya kijamii; fill each from the text.
misconceptions.feedback: Mandhari ni mahali, wakati na hali ambamo matukio yanatokea.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a list of the characters, or a summary of the message, as the ploti.

example.question: Ploti ya "Sauti ya Mama Dunia" ni nini?
example.wrong_answer: orodha ya wahusika: Mama Dunia (nafsineni) na Mkata Miti
example.correct_answer: mfuatano wa matukio tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho

misconceptions.cause: Ploti is a new word and the child grabs what he knows about the work.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ploti ya "Sauti ya Mama Dunia" ni nini?" with "orodha ya wahusika: Mama Dunia (nafsineni) na Mkata Miti" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ploti is the chain of events with cause: because A, then B. Build it with event cards and arrows.
misconceptions.feedback: Ploti ni msuko wa matukio na jinsi yanavyofuatana.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the events of the ploti in the order he remembers them, not the order of the story.

example.question: Ni tukio lipi huja kwanza katika ploti ya "Sauti ya Mama Dunia"?
example.wrong_answer: Mkata Miti anaangusha mti wa mwisho
example.correct_answer: tukio la mwanzo kabisa la kazi

misconceptions.cause: The climax is remembered first.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni tukio lipi huja kwanza katika ploti ya "Sauti ya Mama Dunia"?" with "Mkata Miti anaangusha mti wa mwisho" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Number the events on the page; then check the order against the chapters or scenes.
misconceptions.feedback: Fuata mpangilio wa matukio kama yalivyo katika kazi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Names the mandhari but cannot say why it matters to the story (it is "just where it happened").

example.question: Mandhari ya msitu unaokatwa yana umuhimu gani katika "Sauti ya Mama Dunia"?
example.correct_answer: yanaonyesha hali ya wahusika na kuchangia uharibifu wa mazingira

misconceptions.cause: Setting has been taught as a fact to find, not as a tool of the author.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mandhari ya msitu unaokatwa yana umuhimu gani katika "Sauti ya Mama Dunia"?" with "ni mahali tu hadithi ilipotokea" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: could the story happen the same way anywhere else? What does this place add?
misconceptions.feedback: Mandhari hujenga hali, huonyesha maudhui na huathiri matendo ya wahusika.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Counts the mishororo of the whole poem as the mishororo of one ubeti.

example.question: Shairi lina beti 4 za mishororo 4. Kila ubeti una mishororo mingapi?

misconceptions.cause: The child counts every line on the page.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Shairi lina beti 4 za mishororo 4. Kila ubeti una mishororo mingapi?" with "16" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Box each ubeti; count inside one box only.
misconceptions.feedback: Ubeti mmoja una mishororo yake; usihesabu shairi lote.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Looks for vina at the start of the lines, or only at the end, not in the middle (vina vya kati).

example.question: Vina vya kati hupatikana wapi?

misconceptions.cause: English rhyme is only at the end of the line.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Vina vya kati hupatikana wapi?" with "mwanzoni mwa mshororo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Colour the last syllable of each half-line; compare down the poem.
misconceptions.feedback: Vina vya kati viko mwishoni mwa ukwapi; vya mwisho mwishoni mwa utao.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Counts words or letters, not syllables, as mizani.

example.question: Mizani ya mshororo "Elimu ni ufunguo" ni mingapi?

misconceptions.cause: Counting words is the habit from other subjects.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mizani ya mshororo "Elimu ni ufunguo" ni mingapi?" with "3" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap each syllable; each ends in a vowel.
misconceptions.feedback: Mizani ni idadi ya silabi: E-li-mu-ni-u-fu-ngu-o ni mizani 8.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes the kibwagizo (the line repeated in every ubeti) for an ordinary line, or does not know its use.

example.question: Mshororo unaorudiwa mwishoni mwa kila ubeti huitwa?

misconceptions.cause: The repeated line looks like a printing repeat.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mshororo unaorudiwa mwishoni mwa kila ubeti huitwa?" with "kiitikio cha wimbo tu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Mark the line in each ubeti; say what it stresses.
misconceptions.feedback: Kibwagizo hurudiwa kila ubeti kusisitiza ujumbe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Viakifishi (Theme 8: Misukosuko ya kijamii)
learning_experiences: kutambua matumizi ya mabano na kistari kifupi katika maneno, sentensi au vifungu vya maneno kwenye matini andishi na za kidijitali,
kuandika maneno, sentensi au vifungu vya maneno kuhusu suala lengwa akitumia mabano na kistari kifupi ipasavyo,
kusahihisha kifungu ambacho hakijatumia mabano na kistari kifupi ipasavyo,
kuandika kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali au daftarini kifungu kifupi kwa kutumia mabano na kistari kifupi ipasavyo,
kuwasomea au kuwasambazia wenzake kazi yake kwenye mtandao ili waitolee maoni,
key_inquiry_questions: Je, mabano hutumiwa vipi katika matini?
Je, kistari kifupi hutumiwa vipi katika matini?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili matumizi ya mabano na kistari kifupi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika kifungu na kukisambaza mtandaoni.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika vifungu vyenye matumizi yafaayo ya mabano na kistari kifupi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani na katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Suala la misukosuko ya kijamii: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi au vifungu kuhusu suala lengwa akitumia mabano na kistari kifupi.

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ngeli na Upatanisho wa Kisarufi (Theme 8: Misukosuko ya kijamii)
learning_experiences: kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi vya ngeli ya U-ZI na YA-YA katika sentensi na mafungu ya maneno,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi au vifungu vifupi kwa kuzingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya U-ZI na YA-YA,
kuchopoa nomino za ngeli ya U-ZI na YA-YA kwenye chati, kadi maneno, kapu maneno au katika tarakilishi,
kutaja majina ya vitu katika mazingira ya shuleni yaliyo katika ngeli ya U-ZI na YA-YA,
kutenga nomino za ngeli ya U-ZI na YA-YA katika orodha ya nomino, sentensi au vifungu kwenye vitabu, tarakilishi, chati kwa kuzikolezea wino au kuzipigia mstari,
kuunda sentensi au vifungu vifupi vyenye upatanisho ufaao wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya U-ZI na YA-YA akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la misukosuko ya kijamii,
kuwasilisha kazi yake darasani au kuwasambazia wenzake mtandaoni ili waitolee maoni,
kutunga sentensi zenye upatanisho ufaao wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya U-ZI na YA-YA akitumia nomino za vitu vilivyo katika mazingira ya nyumbani, na kumsomea mzazi au mlezi wake ili amtolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni vitu gani katika mazingira yako vyenye majina yaliyo katika ngeli ya U-ZI na YA-YA?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapotoa mchango wake katika kikundi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi au vifungu vifupi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya U-ZI na YA-YA.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuunda sentensi au vifungu vifupi kwa kuzingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya U-ZI na YA-YA.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomsomea mzazi au mlezi wake sentensi alizounda kwa kutumia nomino za ngeli ya U-ZI na YA-YA katika mazingira ya nyumbani.

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusikiliza kwa Kina (Theme 9: Matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika biashara)
learning_experiences: kutambua sauti /j/ na /nj/ katika maneno,
kusikiliza vitanzandimi katika kifaa cha kidijitali na kutambua maneno yenye sauti /j/ na /nj/ na kuyatamka ipasavyo,
kutamka vitanzandimi vyepesi vinavyohusisha matamshi ya sauti/ j/ na /nj/,
kubuni vitanzandimi vinavyohusisha sauti /j/ na /nj/ na kuvikariri kwa wenzake,
kushiriki mazungumzo na mzazi au mlezi wake kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora ya sauti /j/ na /nj/.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni maneno yapi unayoyajua yaliyo na sauti /j/ na /nj/?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutambua sauti /j/ na /nj/ katika maneno.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kusikiliza vitanzandimi vyenye sauti /j/ na /nj/.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapobuni vitanzandimi vyepesi akitumia maneno yenye sauti /j /na /nj/.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapotamka ipasavyo sauti lengwa na anapochangia katika kazi ya kikundi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki mazungumzo na mzazi/mlezi kwa kuhusisha matamshi bora ya sauti /j / na /nj/.

Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.

skills.name: Tofautisha sauti /j/ na /nj/ katika silabi, maneno na vitanzandimi
skills.mastery: Hears, says and writes the right sound in syllables and words with /j/ na /nj/ (jia and njia, jaa and njaa), picks the word that matches the meaning, and tells a real kitanzandimi from an ordinary sentence, in 8 of 10 new items.

misconceptions.error: Hears or says /nj/ for /j/, so jia (to come by way of) becomes njia (a path or a way).

example.question: Mwalimu anasema: "jia". Umesikia neno lipi?

misconceptions.cause: The nasal (n- or m-) before j is soft and quick; a child who does not hear it writes and says the word without it, or adds it where it does not belong, and the meaning changes.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema: "jia". Umesikia neno lipi?" with "njia" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Say the pair slowly with a hand on the throat (or watching the lips); the child says which word was heard before writing.
misconceptions.feedback: Sikiliza tena: "jia" ina sauti /j/. "njia" ni neno lingine lenye maana nyingine.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the word with the letter of the other sound (njaa where jaa is meant).

example.question: Jaza pengo: ___ maana yake ni "to be full".

misconceptions.cause: The child spells as he speaks; if the two sounds are one sound in his speech, the letter is a guess.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza pengo: ___ maana yake ni "to be full"." with "njaa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Pair each spelling with its meaning on a card; the child sorts the cards by meaning, then by letter.
misconceptions.feedback: Neno lenye maana ya "to be full" ni "jaa". "njaa" lina maana ya "hunger".
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Thinks the two words are one word said in two ways, with one meaning.

example.question: "jaa" na "njaa" ni maneno yenye maana moja?

misconceptions.cause: The child has heard both said by different people for the same thing and takes the difference for an accent.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""jaa" na "njaa" ni maneno yenye maana moja?" with "ndiyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Use both words in two sentences that cannot swap: the child says which sentence breaks.
misconceptions.feedback: Hapana. "jaa" ni to be full, na "njaa" ni hunger.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes any long sentence for a kitanzandimi, though it does not repeat the target sounds.

example.question: Ni kipi ni kitanzandimi?
example.wrong_answer: Biashara ya mtandaoni inakua kwa kasi.
example.correct_answer: Njoroge alijaa njaa njiani akanunua njugu kwa Juma.

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks a kitanzandimi is any sentence that is hard to say, not one built by repeating close sounds.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kipi ni kitanzandimi?" with "Biashara ya mtandaoni inakua kwa kasi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the target sounds in the real kitanzandimi; count them; the ordinary sentence has few or none.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitanzandimi hurudia sauti zinazokaribiana, kama /j/ na /nj/, ili kiwe kigumu kutamka.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Splits the syllable with the nasal wrongly (n-jia instead of keeping the nasal with its consonant).

example.question: Neno "njia" lina silabi zipi?

misconceptions.cause: In Kiswahili every syllable ends in a vowel, and a nasal with its consonant (nd, mb, nj, ng) starts one syllable; the child splits by letters, not by sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "njia" lina silabi zipi?" with "n-jia" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap the word: one clap per vowel; the nasal goes with the consonant after it.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: nji-a.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Theme 9: Matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika biashara)
learning_experiences: kudondoa habari mahususi katika kifungu cha kushawishi,
kueleza maana ya maneno kama yalivyotumika katika kifungu cha kushawishi ili kubainisha matumizi ya lugha shawishi,
kutunga sentensi akitumia msamiati katika matini aliyoisoma ili kubainisha matumizi ya lugha shawishi,
kujibu maswali kutokana na kifungu cha kushawishi alichokisoma,
kutoa muhtasari wa kifungu cha kushawishi alichosoma na kuwasambazia wenzake mtandaoni ili wakitolee maoni,
kutafiti mtandaoni kuhusu matini zinazoshughulikia suala lengwa na kuzisoma.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni mambo gani unazingatia unaposoma kifungu cha kushawishi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapohakiki sentensi zilizotungwa na wenzake kwa kutumia msamiati wa suala lengwa na kutoa maoni.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapoweza kusakura tovuti ili kutafuta matini lengwa na kuisoma kwa kuzingatia maadili. Vilevile, anapoandika muhtasari kwa kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali na kuwatumia wenzake.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposakura mtandaoni ili kupata matini mbalimbali na kuzisoma akizingatia maadili katika usomaji wa kidijitali.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapohakiki sentensi zilizotungwa na wenzake kwa kutumia msamiati wa suala lengwa na kutoa maoni yake.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapotathmini maoni ya wenzake wanapotoa muhtasari wa kifungu cha kushawishi. Pia anapowakosoa wenzake kwa upole.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kwa kuvitunza ipasavyo na kuzingatia maadili.
Uadilifu: mwanafunzi anapochagua matini faafu mtandaoni kwa mujibu wa sifa zinazofaa kuzingatiwa katika uteuzi wa matini husika.
sub_strands.pcis: Elimu ya matumizi ya fedha: mwanafunzi anapopata maarifa mtandaoni kuhusu matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika biashara.

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Kubuni (Theme 9: Matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika biashara)

kueleza ukuzaji wa wazo baina ya aya za insha ya masimulizi
kuandika insha ya masimulizi inayozingatia ukuzaji wa wazo baina ya aya
kufurahia kuandika insha za masimulizi zinazozingatia ukuzaji wa wazo baina ya aya ili kufanikisha mawasiliano

skills.name: Andika insha ya masimulizi ukikuza wazo baina ya aya
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya kubuni from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a creative story built paragraph by paragraph, with characters, a setting and vivid language; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 8 developed an idea in each paragraph.

misconceptions.error: Puts several ideas in one paragraph, or one idea across many tiny paragraphs, so no idea is built up.

example.question: Aya nzuri ya insha "Duka Langu la Mtandaoni" ina nini?
example.correct_answer: wazo moja kuu linalokuzwa kwa maelezo na mifano

misconceptions.cause: Paragraphs are made where the child pauses, not where an idea ends.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Aya nzuri ya insha "Duka Langu la Mtandaoni" ina nini?" with "mawazo mengi tofauti" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Topic sentence first; then two or three sentences that develop only it; a link to the next paragraph.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila aya ikuze wazo moja kuu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the events in an order that cannot have happened (the end before the start), with no linking words.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Duka Langu la Mtandaoni"?
example.wrong_answer: biashara ilistawi, nilitangaza kwa busara, wateja walikuwa wachache, nilianzisha duka
example.correct_answer: nilianzisha duka, wateja walikuwa wachache, nilitangaza kwa busara, biashara ilistawi

misconceptions.cause: The child writes events as they come to mind; nobody has asked for a plan first.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Duka Langu la Mtandaoni"?" with "biashara ilistawi, nilitangaza kwa busara, wateja walikuwa wachache, nilianzisha duka" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Plan with three boxes (mwanzo, kati, mwisho) and linking words (kwanza, kisha, hatimaye) before writing.
misconceptions.feedback: Panga matukio yanavyofuatana, na utumie maneno kama kwanza, kisha na hatimaye.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Switches between "I" and "he" for the narrator, or between views, in one insha.

example.question: Ni lipi ni kosa katika insha moja?
example.correct_answer: kutumia nafsi moja ya msimulizi tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho

misconceptions.cause: The child forgets who is telling the story.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni lipi ni kosa katika insha moja?" with "kuanza "nilikwenda..." kisha "alikwenda..." kwa msimulizi yuleyule" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Decide the narrator before writing; circle every verb of the narrator and check the person.
misconceptions.feedback: Dumisha nafsi na mtazamo mmoja wa msimulizi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Plans with points (vidokezo) that do not belong to the title, or writes the insha without using the points planned.

example.question: Ni kidokezo kipi hakifai kwa insha "Duka Langu la Mtandaoni"?

misconceptions.cause: The child lists whatever comes to mind and does not check each point against the title.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kidokezo kipi hakifai kwa insha "Duka Langu la Mtandaoni"?" with "Bei ya sukari imepanda dukani." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Write the title at the top of the plan; tick each point only if it helps to tell that story.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila kidokezo kinapaswa kusaidia kusimulia kisa cha anwani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ngeli na Upatanisho wa Kisarufi (Theme 9: Matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika biashara)
learning_experiences: kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi vya ngeli ya LI, KU na PA-KU-MU katika sentensi au vifungu,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi au vifungu kwa kuzingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya LI, KU na PA-KU-MU,
kuchopoa nomino za ngeli ya LI, KU na PA-KU-MU kwenye chati, kadi maneno, kapu maneno au katika tarakilishi,
kutaja majina ya vitu katika mazingira ya shuleni yaliyo katika ngeli ya LI, KU na PA-KU-MU,
kutenga nomino za ngeli ya LI, KU na PA-KU-MU katika orodha ya nomino, sentensi au vifungu kwenye vitabu, tarakilishi, chati kwa kuzikolezea wino au kuzipigia mstari,

kutunga sentensi au vifungu vifupi vyenye upatanisho wa kisarufi ufaao wa ngeli ya LI, KU na PA-KU-MU akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika biashara,
kumweleza mzazi, mlezi au mwenzake sentensi alizotunga akitumia nomino katika ngeli za LI, KU na PA-KU-MU ili kutoa maoni yake .
key_inquiry_questions: Ni vitu gani katika mazingira yako vyenye majina yaliyo katika ngeli ya LI, KU na PA-KU-MU?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi kuhusu suala lengwa akitumia nomino za ngeli ya LI, KU na PA-KU-MU.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutumia nomino za ngeli ya LI, KU na PA-KU-MU kuzitungia sentensi na vifungu vyenye upatanisho ufaao wa kisarufi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji, pia anapojitolea kufanya kazi mradi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis: Elimu ya matumizi ya fedha: mwanafunzi anapoandika kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kutumia nomino katika ngeli ya LI, KU na PA-KU-MU.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya ngeli na upatanisho wa kisarufi katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika biashara na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Pre-technical studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi vya ngeli ya LI, KU na PA-KU-MU katika sentensi
kutambua nomino za ngeli ya LI, KU na PA-KU-MU katika matini
kutumia nomino za ngeli ya LI, KU na PA-KU-MU katika matini kwa kuzingatia upatanisho ufaao wa kisarufi
kuchangamkia matumizi yafaayo ya upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya LI, KU na PA-KU-MU katika mawasiliano ya kila siku

skills.name: Tumia ngeli za KU na PA-KU-MU na upatanisho wa kisarufi
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua ngeli ya KU (vitenzi-jina: kusoma kunafurahisha) na ya PA-KU-MU (mahali: hapa pazuri, kule kuzuri, humu mwazuri). Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses ki- for a verbal noun.

example.question: Chagua sentensi sahihi.

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Kusoma kinafurahisha." next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Vitenzi-jina hutumia ku-.
misconceptions.feedback: Vitenzi-jina hutumia ku-.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Uses ku- for a near place.

example.question: Chagua sentensi sahihi.

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Hapa kuzuri." next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Mahali karibu hutumia pa-.
misconceptions.feedback: Mahali karibu hutumia pa-.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Uses pa- for inside.

example.question: Chagua sentensi sahihi.

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Humu pazuri." next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Ndani hutumia mu-.
misconceptions.feedback: Ndani hutumia mu-.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Mixes KU of verbal nouns with KU of place (Kusoma kunapendeza / Kule kunapendeza) and gives the verbal noun place meaning.

example.question: "Kuogelea kwake kulitushangaza." "Ku-" hapa ni ya nini?

misconceptions.cause: The two ku- forms look the same.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""Kuogelea kwake kulitushangaza." "Ku-" hapa ni ya nini?" with "mahali (PA-KU-MU)" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: is it an activity (kuogelea) or a place (kule, nyumbani)?
misconceptions.feedback: Kitenzi-jina ni shughuli; ku- ya mahali huonyesha mahali.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Mazungumzo (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na msongo wa mawazo)
learning_experiences: kutafiti na kueleza maana ya malumbano ya utani,
kutafiti na kujadili na wenzake sifa za malumbano ya utani,
kutambua vipengele vya kimsingi vya uwasilishaji wa malumbano ya utani,
kusikiliza malumbano ya utani katika vifaa vya kidijitali au kutoka kwa mgeni mwalikwa au mwalimu na kutambua vipengele vya kimsingi katika uwasilishaji,
kuwasilisha malumbano ya utani kwa kuzingatia vipengele vya kimsingi katika uwasilishaji wake,
kumweleza mzazi au mlezi jinsi ya kuwasilisha malumbano ya utani kwa kuzingatia vipengele vifaavyo vya uwasilishaji.
key_inquiry_questions: Malumbano ya utani huzungumzia nini?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapowasilisha mazungumzo kwa kuzingatia vipengele vya kimsingi vya mazungumzo.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapowaeleza wenzake namna ya kuwasilisha mazungumzo.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikiliza malumbano ya utani.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapotambua vipengele vya kimsingi vya mazungumzo aliyosikiliza.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomweleza mzazi au mlezi jinsi ya kuwasilisha malumbano ya utani.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Masuala ya afya: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na wenzake kuwasilisha malumbano ya utani kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya malumbano ya utani katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la msongo wa mawazo na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Religious Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya malumbano ya utani kama kipera cha mazungumzo
kujadili sifa za malumbano ya utani
kutambua vipengele vya uwasilishaji wa malumbano ya utani
kuwasilisha malumbano ya utani kwa kuzingatia vipengele vifaavyo vya uwasilishaji
kuchangamkia uwasilishaji wa malumbano ya utani kwa kuzingatia vipengele vya kimsingi katika uwasilishaji

skills.name: Wasilisha mazungumzo kwa kuzingatia vipengele vya uwasilishaji
skills.mastery: Explains the uwasilishaji of mazungumzo (malumbano ya utani, mawaidha) with the right terms and examples, gives evidence or a reason for each point, and presents one with its formula, voice, gestures and audience part (presentation scored by the teacher), in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Taking turns and replying in a debate.
Grade 8 language devices in oral literature.

misconceptions.error: Starts or ends without the opening or closing formula (Mtani wangu!).

example.question: Msimulizi anaanzaje?
example.wrong_answer: anaanza moja kwa moja na kisa

misconceptions.cause: Telling has been practised as reading a text aloud.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Msimulizi anaanzaje?" with "anaanza moja kwa moja na kisa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Practise the formula with the class answering.
misconceptions.feedback: Anza kwa fomula: "Mtani wangu!" - "Naam mtani!"
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Presents in one flat voice, with no change for characters or feelings.

example.question: Unapowasilisha, sauti yako iweje?
example.correct_answer: ibadilike kulingana na mhusika na hisia

misconceptions.cause: The child is shy and keeps the voice safe.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unapowasilisha, sauti yako iweje?" with "moja tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Give each character a voice; rehearse one line in each.
misconceptions.feedback: Badilisha sauti kulingana na mhusika na hisia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses no gestures, or gestures that do not match the words.

example.question: Ni ishara ipi inafaa unapotaja "mlima mrefu"?

misconceptions.cause: The body is forgotten under the stress of remembering words.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ishara ipi inafaa unapotaja "mlima mrefu"?" with "kushika kichwa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Mirror pairs: one says, one shows; swap.
misconceptions.feedback: Ishara ziendane na maneno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Presents to the floor or the teacher only, with no eye contact and no call for responses.

example.question: Unawasilisha mbele ya darasa. Unawaangalia nani?

misconceptions.cause: Reciting for marks is done to the teacher.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unawasilisha mbele ya darasa. Unawaangalia nani?" with "chini au mwalimu peke yake" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Divide the room into three; look at each part in turn.
misconceptions.feedback: Iangalie na uishirikishe hadhira yote.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na msongo wa mawazo)
learning_experiences: kutafiti mtandaoni au maktabani maana ya wahusika katika fasihi,
kutambua wahusika (k.v. nafsineni) katika shairi akishirikiana na wenzake,
kujadili na wenzake sifa za wahusika katika shairi (jinsi ya kutambua sifa za wahusika katika shairi),
kuchambua mashairi kutoka diwani iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu na kujadili sifa za wahusika kutokana na tabia zao, matendo yao, maelezo ya nafsineni kuwahusu, sura, umbo n.k,
kuigiza wahusika katika mashairi ili kukuza uelewa wa sifa zao,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi wake shairi na kujadiliana naye kuhusu wahusika.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni wahusika gani uliokumbana nao katika mashairi uliyowahi kuya-soma?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kusoma mashairi akiwa na wenzake.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoweza kusoma mashairi kwa mahadhi yafaayo katika kikundi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika usomaji wa shairi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoigiza wahusika katika mashairi.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapochambua wahusika katika mashairi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomsomea mzazi au mlezi mashairi na kujadiliana naye kuhusu wahusika.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika majadiliano ya uchambuzi wa mashairi katika kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani na katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Masuala ya afya: mwanafunzi anapochambua ujumbe wa shairi kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya kusoma kwa kina katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la msongo wa mawazo na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Religious Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya wahusika katika fasihi
kutambua wahusika katika shairi
kujadili sifa za wahusika katika shairi
kuchambua shairi kwa kuzingatia sifa za wahusika
kujenga mazoea ya kuchambua wahusika katika mashairi ili kuimarisha uwazaji wa kina

skills.name: Chambua wahusika na sifa zao katika shairi
skills.mastery: Explains the wahusika of a shairi read in class ("Sauti ya Mama Dunia") with a correct term, gives evidence from the text for every point, and says why it matters to the work, in 8 of 10 new items (longer written answers marked by the teacher).

misconceptions.error: Takes a minor character who appears often for the main character.

example.question: Mhusika mkuu katika "Sauti ya Mama Dunia" ni nani?

misconceptions.cause: The child counts appearances, not who the story is about.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mhusika mkuu katika "Sauti ya Mama Dunia" ni nani?" with "Mkata Miti" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask whose problem the story follows from start to end.
misconceptions.feedback: Mhusika mkuu ni yule ambaye kazi inamhusu tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a trait with no action from the text to show it.

example.question: Mama Dunia (nafsineni) ni mwenye huruma. Ni ushahidi upi unaothibitisha?
example.wrong_answer: ni mwenye huruma kwa sababu ni mhusika mzuri

misconceptions.cause: The child knows a trait must be named but not that it must be shown.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mama Dunia (nafsineni) ni mwenye huruma. Ni ushahidi upi unaothibitisha?" with "ni mwenye huruma kwa sababu ni mhusika mzuri" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Use the frame: trait + "kwa sababu" + an action from the text.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila sifa ithibitishwe kwa kitendo cha mhusika katika kazi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives how the character looks (mrefu, mrembo) when the character's nature is asked.

example.question: Taja sifa ya kitabia ya Mama Dunia (nafsineni).

misconceptions.cause: Describing people starts with appearance in lower grades.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Taja sifa ya kitabia ya Mama Dunia (nafsineni)." with "mrefu na mwembamba" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Two columns: sura (looks) and tabia (character); sort the words.
misconceptions.feedback: Sifa za kitabia ni kama ukarimu, uchoyo, ujasiri; si urefu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes the behaviour of a bad character as the lesson to copy.

example.question: Tunajifunza nini kutokana na matendo ya Mkata Miti?
example.correct_answer: tuepuke tabia mbaya kama zake kwa sababu zina madhara

misconceptions.cause: The bad character often wins for a while, and the child sees the gain, not the end.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tunajifunza nini kutokana na matendo ya Mkata Miti?" with "tufanye kama yeye ili tufanikiwe" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Follow the character to the end of the work: what did his actions bring?
misconceptions.feedback: Tunajifunza kuepuka tabia mbaya kwa kuona matokeo yake.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na msongo wa mawazo)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya barua rasmi ya kuomba kazi,
kutambua vipengele vya kimuundo vya barua rasmi ya kuomba kazi,

Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuandika barua rasmi ya kuomba kazi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomsomea mzazi au mlezi wake barua rasmi ya kuomba kazi.

Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya barua rasmi ya kuomba kazi
kutambua vipengele vya barua rasmi ya kuomba kazi
kuandika barua rasmi ya kuomba kazi akizingatia vipengele vyake
kujenga mazoea ya kuandika barua rasmi ya kuomba kazi ipasavyo

skills.name: Tambua vipengele vya barua rasmi ya kuomba kazi
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua anwani mbili, tarehe, salamu rasmi, kichwa cha barua, utangulizi, sifa za mwombaji, hitimisho na jina, na kuwa lugha ni ya heshima. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 8 official letter asking for help.

skills.name: Andika barua rasmi ya kuomba kazi
skills.mastery: Tells barua rasmi from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes an official letter with two addresses, the date, a formal greeting, a KUH: line, the message and Wako mtiifu with a signature; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: The features of a job application letter.

misconceptions.error: Gives one address.

example.question: Barua ya kuomba kazi ina anwani ngapi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "moja" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Ina anwani mbili.
misconceptions.feedback: Ina anwani mbili.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Leaves out the heading.

example.question: Barua ya kuomba kazi huwa na nini kabla ya ujumbe?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "hakuna kitu" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Ina kichwa cha barua.
misconceptions.feedback: Ina kichwa cha barua.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Leaves out the applicant's qualifications.

example.question: Barua ya kuomba kazi hutaja nini kuhusu mwombaji?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "rangi yake anayopenda" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Hutaja sifa za mwombaji.
misconceptions.feedback: Hutaja sifa za mwombaji.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Writes only one address, or puts the receiver's address at the top right.

example.question: Barua rasmi ina anwani ngapi?
example.correct_answer: mbili: ya mwandishi (kulia juu) na ya mpokeaji (kushoto)

misconceptions.cause: The friendly letter has one address and the child carries it over.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Barua rasmi ina anwani ngapi?" with "moja, ya mwandishi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Label both addresses on a model; the child writes his own and the receiver's on a blank layout.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua rasmi ina anwani mbili: ya mwandishi kulia juu, ya mpokeaji kushoto chini yake.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves out the subject line (KUH: or YAH:) or writes it as a long sentence.

example.question: Ni kichwa kipi kinafaa katika barua rasmi kuhusu ombi la kazi ya muda likizoni?
example.wrong_answer: Nimeandika barua hii kwa sababu ninataka kukueleza mambo mengi.
example.correct_answer: KUH: OMBI LA KAZI YA MUDA LIKIZONI

misconceptions.cause: The child does not know the reader of an official letter needs the subject before reading.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kichwa kipi kinafaa katika barua rasmi kuhusu ombi la kazi ya muda likizoni?" with "Nimeandika barua hii kwa sababu ninataka kukueleza mambo mengi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the KUH: line on three real letters; it is short and in capitals.
misconceptions.feedback: Kichwa cha barua rasmi huanza KUH: au YAH: na huandikwa kwa herufi kubwa, kwa ufupi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses friendly words in an official letter (Mpendwa rafiki, Hujambo?, Wako akupendaye).

example.question: Ni salamu ipi inafaa katika barua kwa Mwalimu Mkuu?

misconceptions.cause: The friendly letter is the first letter learnt and its words come first.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni salamu ipi inafaa katika barua kwa Mwalimu Mkuu?" with "Hujambo mwalimu wangu mpendwa!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Sort salamu and closing cards into "kirafiki" and "rasmi".
misconceptions.feedback: Barua rasmi hutumia lugha rasmi: Kwa Mwalimu Mkuu, Wako mtiifu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Ends with only a first name and no signature, or with "Ni mimi rafiki yako".

example.question: Barua rasmi humalizika vipi?
example.correct_answer: Wako mtiifu, sahihi, na jina kamili: Wanjiku Kamau

misconceptions.cause: The friendly closing is a habit.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Barua rasmi humalizika vipi?" with "Ni mimi rafiki yako, Wanjiku" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Model the closing block (Wako mtiifu, sahihi, jina kamili) and have the child copy it once.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua rasmi humalizika kwa "Wako mtiifu," sahihi na jina kamili.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Asks for the job without saying what qualifies him (skills, education, experience) or how to reach him.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni muhimu katika barua ya kuomba kazi?
example.correct_answer: Nimehitimu darasa la tisa na nina ujuzi wa kutumia tarakilishi.

misconceptions.cause: The child writes about his need, not what he offers.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni muhimu katika barua ya kuomba kazi?" with "Ninahitaji pesa sana." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Plan: the job asked for, qualifications, why you fit, how to contact you.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua ya kuomba kazi hueleza sifa na ujuzi wa mwombaji.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Vinyume vya Vihusishi (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na msongo wa mawazo)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya vinyume vya vihusishi,
kutambua matumizi sahihi ya vinyume vya vihusishi kutoka katika vitabu, tarakilishi au chati,
kuchagua sentensi zinazoashiria matumizi ya vinyume vya vihusishi kutokana na mchanganyiko wa sentensi kutoka kwenye vitabu, tarakilishi, chati kwa kuzikolezea wino au kuzipigia mstari,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi au kifungu kwa kutumia vinyume vya vihusishi ipasavyo,
kuandika sentensi upya kwa kuzingatia vinyume vya vihusishi,
kutunga sentensi au kifungu kifupi kuonyesha matumizi ya vinyume vya vihusishi akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la kukabiliana na msongo wa mawazo,
kumsomea mzazi, mlezi au mwenzake sentensi zenye vihusishi na vinyume vyake vinavyotokea katika mazingira ya nyumbani.
key_inquiry_questions: Kwa nini tunatumia vinyume vya vihusishi katika mawasiliano?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapotoa mchango katika shughuli za kikundi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutambua vinyume vya vihusishi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi kuonyesha vinyume vya vihusishi.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua vinyume vya vihusishi na kuvitungia sentensi sahihi.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapotambua au kutunga sentensi sahihi kuhusu vinyume vya vihusishi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani na katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Kukabiliana na msongo wa mawazo: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya vinyume katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la msongo wa mawazo na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Religious Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya vinyume vya vihusishi
kutambua vinyume vya vihusishi katika matini
kutumia vinyume vya vihusishi ipasavyo katika matini
kujenga mazoea ya kutumia ipasavyo vinyume vya vihusishi

skills.name: Tambua vinyume vya vihusishi
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua vinyume vya vihusishi (mbele ya na nyuma ya, juu ya na chini ya, ndani ya na nje ya, kabla ya na baada ya). Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Gives the wrong opposite.

example.question: Kinyume cha juu ya ni kipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "mbele ya" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kinyume cha juu ya ni chini ya.
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume cha juu ya ni chini ya.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Gives the wrong opposite.

example.question: Kinyume cha ndani ya ni kipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "juu ya" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kinyume cha ndani ya ni nje ya.
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume cha ndani ya ni nje ya.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Gives the wrong opposite.

example.question: Kinyume cha kabla ya ni kipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "wakati wa" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kinyume cha kabla ya ni baada ya.
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume cha kabla ya ni baada ya.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Makes the opposite of a relating word with si (si juu ya) instead of its opposite (chini ya).

example.question: Kinyume cha "ndani ya" ni?

misconceptions.cause: Negation is a quick way to say not.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "ndani ya" ni?" with "si ndani ya" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Pair cards: juu ya/chini ya, ndani ya/nje ya, kabla ya/baada ya, mbele ya/nyuma ya.
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume cha kihusishi ni kihusishi kingine: nje ya.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Uzungumzaji Katika Sherehe (Theme 11: Haki za kibinadamu)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya uzungumzaji katika sherehe,
kutambua miktadha katika kijamii yake ambamo uzungumzaji katika miktadha ya sherehe hufanywa,
kusakura katika mtandao kutafiti ujumbe unaoafiki uzungumzaji katika miktadha mbalimbali ya sherehe,
kusikiliza uzungumzaji wa aina mbalimbali kutoka kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali, mwalimu au mgeni mwalikwa na kubainisha ule unaohusu muktadha wa sherehe,
kutafiti na kujadili na wenzake vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kuzungumza katika miktadha ya sherehe,
kuigiza uzungumzaji katika miktadha ya sherehe huku akizingatia vipengele vya uwasilishaji wa uzungumzaji wa aina hii.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni mambo gani ya kuzingatia wakati wa kuzungumza katika muktadha wa sherehe?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapoeleza maana ya uzungumzaji katika miktadha ya sherehe.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapobuni maigizo kuhusu uzungumzaji katika miktadha ya sherehe.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoweza kuigiza uzungumzaji katika muktadha wa sherehe akizingatia vipengele vya uwasilishaji wa uzungumzaji wa aina hii.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapojadili vipengele vya kuzingatia katika uzungumzaji katika miktadha ya sherehe.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake zamu ya kushiriki katika uzungumzaji.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapovitunza vifaa vya kidijitali alivyotumia kusakura katika mtandao kutafiti ujumbe unaoafiki uzungumzaji katika miktadha ya sherehe.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na wengine na kuchangia katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis: Uraia: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika uzungumzaji kuhusu haki za binadamu.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya uzungumzaji katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la haki za binadamu na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Religious Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya uzungumzaji katika sherehe
kutambua miktadha katika jamii ambapo uzungumzaji katika sherehe hufanywa
kujadili ujumbe tofautitofauti unaoafiki uzungumzaji katika miktadha mbalimbali ya sherehe
kujadili vipengele vya kuzingatia katika uzungumzaji katika muktadha wa sherehe
kutoa mazungumzo katika muktadha wa sherehe kwa kutumia vipengele vifaavyo
kuchangamkia mazungumzo yafaayo katika miktadha ya sherehe

skills.name: Zungumza katika muktadha wa sherehe
skills.mastery: Names the features to keep in this kind of talk (sherehe), picks the better of two ways to listen or reply in a situation on sherehe ya kuhitimu darasa la tisa, and takes part in one in standard Kiswahili, judged by the teacher with the KICD rubric; in the app, 8 of 10 new items right.

misconceptions.error: Skips the order of greeting the guests (itifaki) at a ceremony.

example.question: Unatoa hotuba katika sherehe. Unaanza vipi?
example.correct_answer: Mheshimiwa mgeni rasmi, walimu, wazazi na wanafunzi wenzangu, hamjambo?

misconceptions.cause: The child does not know the formal order.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unatoa hotuba katika sherehe. Unaanza vipi?" with "Habari zenu?" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Write the itifaki with the guests in order of rank.
misconceptions.feedback: Anza kwa itifaki: mgeni rasmi kwanza, kisha wengine.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a message that does not fit the ceremony (sad words at a wedding).

example.question: Ni ujumbe upi unafaa katika sherehe ya kuhitimu?
example.correct_answer: hongera na heri katika masomo yajayo

misconceptions.cause: The child uses the formula he knows best.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ujumbe upi unafaa katika sherehe ya kuhitimu?" with "pole kwa msiba" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Match ceremonies to messages on cards.
misconceptions.feedback: Ujumbe ulingane na sherehe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses Sheng or English words in a formal talk.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika mazungumzo rasmi?

misconceptions.cause: The child talks as with friends.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika mazungumzo rasmi?" with "Ma-guys, hii issue ni serious." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Record and replay; replace each non-Kiswahili word.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia Kiswahili sanifu katika mazungumzo rasmi.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Listens or speaks without looking at the other person (looks down or away).

example.question: Ni ishara ipi inaonyesha unasikiliza kwa makini?

misconceptions.cause: Looking away is a sign of respect at home for some children; in class talk it reads as not listening.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ishara ipi inaonyesha unasikiliza kwa makini?" with "kuangalia chini muda wote" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Practise in pairs: listen with eyes on the speaker and nods; then swap.
misconceptions.feedback: Mwangalie mzungumzaji ili aone unamsikiliza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Mapana (Theme 11: Haki za kibinadamu)
learning_experiences: kuchagua matini ya kiwango chake na kuisoma,
kueleza wenzake ujumbe wa matini ya kujichagulia aliyosoma,
kutambua msamiati uliotumiwa katika matini ya kujichagulia,
kutumia kamusi kutafuta maana ya maneno asiyoyajua,
kujenga rekodi ya msamiati na matumizi mengine ya lugha aliyojifunza katika kitabu au shajara yake,
kutunga sentensi akitumia msamiati katika matini aliyoisoma,
kutoa muhtasari wa matini ya kujichagulia aliyosoma na kuwasilisha kwa wenzake ili waitolee maoni,
kusakura mtandaoni na kujichagulia matini ya ziada kisha aisome,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi wake muhtasari wa matini ya kujichagulia aliyosoma ili amtolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Unazingatia nini unapochagua matini ya kusoma?
Ni mambo gani unayoyazingatia wakati wa kusoma matini ya kujichagulia?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapoeleza ujumbe wa matini ya kujichagulia aliyosoma.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoeleza ujumbe wa matini ya kujichagulia akizingatia ufasaha wa lugha.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotumia kwa usahihi msamiati katika matini aliyoisoma.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapojichagulia matini ya kusoma na kutafuta maana za maneno asiyoyajua kwenye kamusi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anaposakura mtandaoni na kujichagulia matini ya kusoma.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapokubaliana na maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani na katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Masuala ya haki za binadamu: mwanafunzi anaposoma matini kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya kusoma kwa mapana katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la haki za binadamu na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Religious Studies.

outcomes.text: kuteua matini ya kusoma ya kiwango chake
kueleza ujumbe katika matini ya kujichagulia
kutambua maana ya msamiati na matumizi mengine ya lugha katika matini ya kujichagulia
kutumia msamiati aliojifunza ipasavyo katika sentensi
kufurahia kusoma matini ya kujichagulia ili kujenga ufasaha wa lugha

skills.name: Chagua matini ya kusoma na ueleze ujumbe wake
skills.mastery: Chooses a text that suits his reading level and interest from its title, blurb and first page (not from the cover alone), tells the kind of text (hadithi, shairi, makala, gazeti), says its message in one sentence, and works out a new word from the sentence around it, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 8 chose a text of the right level.
Theme 2 message of a chosen text.

misconceptions.error: Chooses a book by its cover picture or its thickness only.

example.question: Unataka kusoma kuhusu haki za kibinadamu. Utachaguaje kitabu?
example.correct_answer: kwa kusoma anwani, maelezo ya nyuma na ukurasa wa kwanza

misconceptions.cause: Nobody has shown the child the title, the blurb and the first page as clues.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unataka kusoma kuhusu haki za kibinadamu. Utachaguaje kitabu?" with "kwa picha nzuri ya jalada" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Hold up two books; read the title and the back of each aloud; the child chooses and says which clue decided it.
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani, maelezo ya nyuma ya kitabu na ukurasa wa kwanza hukuambia kitabu kinahusu nini.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Chooses a text far above his reading level and gives up after a page.

example.question: Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Mwanga wa Haki" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: chagua matini nyingine iliyo ya kiwango chako

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks a harder book is a better book, or chooses the book a friend chose.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Mwanga wa Haki" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?" with "endelea tu hata kama huelewi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: The five-finger check: on one page, a finger for each unknown word; five fingers means the book is too hard for now.
misconceptions.feedback: Matini ifaayo ni ile unayoweza kuisoma na kuielewa ukiwa peke yako.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the title as the message of the text.

example.question: Ujumbe wa matini "Mwanga wa Haki" ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Kila binadamu ana haki sawa ambazo lazima ziheshimiwe.

misconceptions.cause: The title is the only sentence about the whole text that the child is sure of.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa matini "Mwanga wa Haki" ni upi?" with "Mwanga wa Haki" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask what the writer wants the reader to learn or do; the title only names the topic.
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani hutaja mada; ujumbe ni funzo au wazo kuu ambalo mwandishi anataka ulipate.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives one detail of the text as its message.

example.question: Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu haki za kibinadamu?
example.correct_answer: Kila binadamu ana haki sawa ambazo lazima ziheshimiwe.

misconceptions.cause: The detail was striking and is remembered; the child has not asked what the whole text is about.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu haki za kibinadamu?" with "Mwandishi alizaliwa mwaka 1990." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Two boxes: "ujumbe" (one) and "maelezo" (many); the child sorts sentences from the text.
misconceptions.feedback: Ujumbe unahusu matini yote; jambo moja dogo ni maelezo tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Does not tell one kind of text from another (takes a newspaper report for a story, or a poem for a story).

example.question: Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child has met most texts as "kitabu" and has not been shown the signs of each kind.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?" with "hadithi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Lay out a story, a poem, a newspaper page and a dictionary; the child names one sign of each.
misconceptions.feedback: Shairi lina beti na mishororo; hadithi ina aya; gazeti lina habari na tarehe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Guesses a new word from how it looks, not from the sentence it is in (usawa).

example.question: Katika matini: "Katiba inasisitiza usawa wa watu wote mbele ya sheria." Neno "usawa" lina maana gani?
example.correct_answer: hali ya kuwa sawa bila ubaguzi

misconceptions.cause: The child matches the word to a word it looks like instead of reading the sentence around it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika matini: "Katiba inasisitiza usawa wa watu wote mbele ya sheria." Neno "usawa" lina maana gani?" with "kusawazisha ardhi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Cover the word; the child reads the sentence and says what word would fit; then compares.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma sentensi nzima: "usawa" hapa ni hali ya kuwa sawa bila ubaguzi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher
