skills.name: Andika insha ya maelezo kwa mtazamo mahususi
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya maelezo from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a description or explanation with exact vocabulary, ordered paragraphs and vivid language; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

misconceptions.error: Switches between "I" and "he" for the narrator, or between views, in one insha.

example.question: Ni lipi ni kosa katika insha moja?
example.correct_answer: kutumia nafsi moja ya msimulizi tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho

misconceptions.cause: The child forgets who is telling the story.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni lipi ni kosa katika insha moja?" with "kuanza "nilikwenda..." kisha "alikwenda..." kwa msimulizi yuleyule" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Decide the narrator before writing; circle every verb of the narrator and check the person.
misconceptions.feedback: Dumisha nafsi na mtazamo mmoja wa msimulizi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Haki ya Mtoto Kusikilizwa", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Kwa mtazamo wangu kama mwanafunzi, mtoto akisikilizwa hujiamini na hujifunza kuwajibika.

misconceptions.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Haki ya Mtoto Kusikilizwa", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the whole insha as one paragraph with no utangulizi, kiini and hitimisho.

example.question: Insha "Haki ya Mtoto Kusikilizwa" ina sehemu zipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child writes until the space is full and has not planned the parts.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Insha "Haki ya Mtoto Kusikilizwa" ina sehemu zipi?" with "aya moja ndefu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Fold the page into three; one part in each; one idea per paragraph in the middle.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ina utangulizi, kiini chenye aya kadhaa, na hitimisho.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses vague or repeated words (kitu, kizuri, sana sana) where an exact word is needed.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ina msamiati ufaao kuhusu "Haki ya Mtoto Kusikilizwa"?
example.correct_answer: Kwa mtazamo wangu kama mwanafunzi, mtoto akisikilizwa hujiamini na hujifunza kuwajibika.

misconceptions.cause: The child writes as he talks and has a small store of exact words.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ina msamiati ufaao kuhusu "Haki ya Mtoto Kusikilizwa"?" with "Haki ni nzuri." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Keep a theme word bank; replace every "kitu" and "kizuri" from it.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia neno mahususi badala ya maneno ya jumla.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

skills.name: Tambua kauli ya kutendana, kutendeana na kutendesha

misconceptions.feedback: Pigana ni kutendana.

misconceptions.error: Forms the causative with -isha for every verb (laisha, liaisha) where the verb has its own form (laza, lisha).

skills.mastery: Reads a short passage aloud at a speaking pace, pauses at the koma and the kikomo, raises the voice for a question and shows feeling for an exclamation, says every sound clearly (no l for r), and uses a matching gesture, judged by the teacher with the KICD rubric; in the app picks the better reading of a line in 8 of 10 new items.

misconceptions.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Uvutaji wa sigara na unywaji wa pombe huharibu mapafu na ini."?
example.wrong_answer: Uvutaji ... wa ... sigara ... na ... unywaji ... wa ... pombe ... huharibu ... mapafu ... na ... ini.
example.correct_answer: Uvutaji wa sigara na unywaji wa pombe huharibu mapafu na ini.

misconceptions.cause: The child is still decoding each word and has not yet learnt to read a phrase as one piece.

misconceptions.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it as one breath; then phrase-cut the passage with slashes.

misconceptions.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.correct_answer: kwenye koma na kwenye kikomo au alama ya hisi

misconceptions.cause: The marks are read as decoration; the child has not linked them to breath.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unasoma: "Hongera, umeacha kuvuta sigara!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?" with "hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap once at a koma, twice at a kikomo while reading together.
misconceptions.feedback: Simama kidogo kwenye koma, na zaidi kwenye kikomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Says /l/ for /r/ or /r/ for /l/ while reading (sigara read as sigala).

example.question: Neno "sigara" linatamkwa vipi?

misconceptions.cause: The first language of the child does not separate these sounds, so the reading carries the home sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "sigara" linatamkwa vipi?" with "sigala" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Make a list of the passage words with the hard sound; practise them before reading the passage.
misconceptions.feedback: Tamka "sigara" kama lilivyoandikwa; "sigala" ni neno jingine au si neno.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Hotuba ya Kushawishi (Theme 12: Magonjwa yanayotokana na mienendo ya maisha)
learning_experiences: kutafiti na kueleza maana ya hotuba ya kushawishi,
kutambua hotuba ya kushawishi katika matini,
kujadili vipengele vya kuzingatia katika uandishi wa hotuba ya kushawishi,
kusoma kielelezo cha hotuba ya kushawishi na kujadili na wenzake vipengele vilivyotumiwa katika hotuba hiyo,
kujadili na wenzake vidokezo vinavyoweza kutumiwa katika kuandika hotuba ya kushawishi,
kuandika hotuba ya kushawishi kuhusu suala lengwa akitumia vidokezo walivyovijadili,
kuwasomea wenzake hotuba yake au kumsambazia kupitia mtandao ili waitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Unazingatia nini ili kufanya hotuba kuwa na ushawishi kwa wasomaji?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na wenzake katika kujadili vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kuandika hotuba ya kushawishi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kuandika hotuba ya kushawishi na kuisambaza kwa mtandao.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika hotuba ya kushawishi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapokubaliana na maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani na katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Uraia: mwanafunzi anapoandika hotuba ya kushawishi kuhusu suala lengwa.
Masuala ya afya: mwanafunzi anapoandika hotuba kuhusu suala lengwa.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya hotuba ya kushawishi ili kuitofautisha na aina nyingine za hotuba
kujadili vipengele vya kuzingatia katika uandishi wa hotuba ya kushawishi
kuandika hotuba ya kushawishi akizingatia vipengele vifaavyo
kuchangamkia kuandika ipasavyo hotuba ya kushawishi

skills.name: Eleza hotuba ya kushawishi na vipengele vyake
skills.mastery: Mtoto hueleza hotuba ya kushawishi hulenga kumfanya msikilizaji akubali wazo au achukue hatua, na hutambua salamu, utangulizi, hoja, mifano, wito na shukrani. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

skills.name: Andika hotuba ya kushawishi kwa kuzingatia vipengele vyake
skills.mastery: Tells hotuba from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a speech with the itifaki, words spoken to the audience, facts the listener can use and a closing with thanks; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: The features of a persuasive speech.

misconceptions.error: Thinks a persuasive speech only informs.

example.question: Hotuba ya kushawishi hulenga nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "kuburudisha tu" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Hotuba ya kushawishi hulenga kushawishi.
misconceptions.feedback: Hotuba ya kushawishi hulenga kushawishi.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Starts with the call to action.

example.question: Hotuba huanza kwa nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "wito" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Hotuba huanza kwa salamu na utangulizi.
misconceptions.feedback: Hotuba huanza kwa salamu na utangulizi.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Leaves out reasons.

example.question: Hotuba ya kushawishi hutumia nini kuunga wazo?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "hoja na mifano" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Hutumia hoja na mifano.
misconceptions.feedback: Hutumia hoja na mifano.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Starts the speech with no greeting of the guests in order (itifaki).

example.question: Hotuba huanza vipi?
example.wrong_answer: moja kwa moja na hoja ya kwanza
example.correct_answer: kwa itifaki: Mheshimiwa mgeni rasmi, walimu, wazazi...

misconceptions.cause: The child writes a speech like an insha.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Hotuba huanza vipi?" with "moja kwa moja na hoja ya kwanza" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Model the itifaki line and the order of rank.
misconceptions.feedback: Hotuba huanza kwa itifaki.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes about the listeners in the third person instead of speaking to them (Wanafunzi wanapaswa... instead of Wanafunzi wenzangu, tunapaswa...).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika hotuba?

misconceptions.cause: The speech is written, so it takes the voice of an essay.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika hotuba?" with "Wanafunzi wanapaswa kunawa mikono." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the draft aloud to the class; change every "wao" to "sisi" or "nyinyi".
misconceptions.feedback: Hotuba huzungumza na hadhira moja kwa moja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Ends without thanking the audience or closing (Asanteni kwa kunisikiliza).

example.question: Hotuba humalizika vipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child stops when the points run out.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Hotuba humalizika vipi?" with "kwa hoja ya mwisho tu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Model a closing: a call to act and thanks.
misconceptions.feedback: Funga hotuba kwa muhtasari na shukrani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives an information speech with no facts the listener can use (dates, places, steps).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika hotuba ya kupasha habari kuhusu tuepuke vyakula visivyo na afya?
example.correct_answer: Chanjo itatolewa katika zahanati ya Ruaka kuanzia Jumatatu ijayo.

misconceptions.cause: The child gives feelings, not information.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika hotuba ya kupasha habari kuhusu tuepuke vyakula visivyo na afya?" with "Ugonjwa huu ni mbaya sana." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Check the speech against nani, nini, lini, wapi, vipi.
misconceptions.feedback: Hotuba ya kupasha habari hutoa ukweli muhimu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Persuades with feelings only and no facts, examples or answers to the other side.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inashawishi zaidi katika hotuba kuhusu vyakula visivyo na afya?
example.wrong_answer: Vyakula hivi ni vibaya sana sana!
example.correct_answer: Utafiti unaonyesha kwamba vinywaji vyenye sukari nyingi huchangia kisukari; tuchague maji.

misconceptions.cause: Strong feeling seems like strong persuasion.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inashawishi zaidi katika hotuba kuhusu vyakula visivyo na afya?" with "Vyakula hivi ni vibaya sana sana!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Each point: claim, fact or example, benefit to the listener.
misconceptions.feedback: Hotuba ya kushawishi hutumia ukweli na mifano, si hisia tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Aina za Sentensi (Theme 12: Magonjwa yanayotokana na mienendo ya maisha)

kutambua sentensi tata zinazojitokeza katika matini mbalimbali,
kutolea wenzake maana tofauti za sentensi tata alizozitambua,
kutunga sentensi tata kwa kuzingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la magonjwa yanayotokana na mienendo ya maisha,
kuwasilisha darasani sentensi tata alizotunga ili wenzake wazitolee maoni kwa heshima na upendo,
kumtungia mzazi au mlezi wake sentensi tata zinazohusu shughuli katika mazingira ya nyumbani.

Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi tata ipasavyo.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua sentensi tata katika kifungu.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomtungia mzazi au mlezi wake sentensi tata zinazohusu shughuli katika mazingira ya nyumbani.

skills.name: Tambua sentensi tata
skills.mastery: Mtoto hueleza sentensi tata ni yenye maana zaidi ya moja kutokana na muundo wake, kama "Mama alimpiga mtoto na fimbo". Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Words with more than one meaning.

misconceptions.error: Thinks a tata sentence has one meaning.

example.question: Sentensi tata ina nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "maana moja tu" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Sentensi tata ina maana zaidi ya moja.
misconceptions.feedback: Sentensi tata ina maana zaidi ya moja.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Calls a clear sentence tata.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni tata?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Mama anapika." next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Sentensi tata inaweza kufasiriwa kwa njia mbili.
misconceptions.feedback: Sentensi tata inaweza kufasiriwa kwa njia mbili.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Does not know the cause of the ambiguity.

example.question: Sentensi tata hutokana na nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "matumizi ya herufi kubwa" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Muundo huleta maana mbili.
misconceptions.feedback: Muundo huleta maana mbili.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Gives only one meaning of an ambiguous sentence (Alimpigia mpira: kicked the ball to him, or kicked the ball for him).

example.question: "Mama alimpikia mtoto chakula" ina maana ngapi?
example.correct_answer: mbili au zaidi: alimpikia kwa niaba yake au kumpa

misconceptions.cause: The child reads the meaning that comes first.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""Mama alimpikia mtoto chakula" ina maana ngapi?" with "moja" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the sentence as two different speakers would; draw each meaning.
misconceptions.feedback: Sentensi tata ina maana zaidi ya moja: eleza zote.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Mazungumzo (Theme 13: Mshikamano wa kijamii)

kujadili na wenzake ujumbe wa mawaidha ya kifasihi,
kujadili na wenzake sifa za mawaidha ya kifasihi,
kueleza vipengele vya uwasilishaji wa mawaidha,
kutambua washiriki (fanani na hadhira) katika mawaidha anayosikiliza,
kuchambua sifa za washiriki katika mawaidha anayosikiliza kutoka kwa vifaa vya kidijitali, mgeni mwalikwa au mwalimu,
kutunga mawaidha kuhusu suala lengwa na kuwawasilishia wenzake darasani,

skills.name: Chambua wahusika katika mazungumzo
skills.mastery: Explains the wahusika of mazungumzo (mawaidha, malumbano ya utani) with the right terms and examples, gives evidence or a reason for each point, and presents one with its formula, voice, gestures and audience part (presentation scored by the teacher), in 8 of 10 new items.

misconceptions.error: Names a character who only appears once as the main one.

example.question: Mhusika mkuu katika mazungumzo hii ni nani?

misconceptions.cause: The child picks the most striking name.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mhusika mkuu katika mazungumzo hii ni nani?" with "mhusika aliyetajwa mara moja" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask whom the whole text is about.
misconceptions.feedback: Mhusika mkuu ni yule ambaye utungo unamhusu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a trait with no line or action as evidence.

example.question: Bibi (mwawaidhi) ni mwenye hekima. Thibitisha.
example.correct_answer: anatumia methali na mifano kuwaonya wajukuu

misconceptions.cause: Naming the trait feels like the answer.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Bibi (mwawaidhi) ni mwenye hekima. Thibitisha." with "kwa sababu ni mzuri" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Frame: sifa + kwa sababu + action.
misconceptions.feedback: Thibitisha sifa kwa kitendo au maneno ya mhusika.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes an animal character literally, not as standing for people (Sungura is just a hare).

example.question: Katika mazungumzo, Bibi (mwawaidhi) anawakilisha nini?
example.correct_answer: watu wenye tabia kama zake katika jamii

misconceptions.cause: Animal characters look like animal facts.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika mazungumzo, Bibi (mwawaidhi) anawakilisha nini?" with "mnyama wa porini tu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask which people in the community behave like this character.
misconceptions.feedback: Wahusika wanyama huwakilisha tabia za watu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Draws the wrong lesson from a character (copy the trickster because he won).

example.question: Tunajifunza nini kutokana na mhusika mjanja aliyeadhibiwa mwishoni?

misconceptions.cause: The trick is remembered; the ending is not.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tunajifunza nini kutokana na mhusika mjanja aliyeadhibiwa mwishoni?" with "tuwe wajanja ili tushinde" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Trace the character to the end: what did he gain and lose?
misconceptions.feedback: Funzo hutokana na matokeo ya matendo ya mhusika.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 13: Mshikamano wa kijamii)
learning_experiences: kutafiti na kutambua mbinu za lugha katika fasihi,
kujadili mbinu za lugha kwa mujibu wa mashairi aliyosoma akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutunga shairi jepesi (lisilozidi beti tatu) kwa kuzingatia mbinu mbalimbali za lugha na kuliwasilisha darasani,
kuhakiki uwasilishaji wa wenzake kuhusu matumizi ya mbinu mbalimbali za lugha katika mashairi waliyotunga na kuyatolea maoni,
kusoma mashairi katika diwani ya mashairi iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu na kuyachambua kwa kuzingatia mbinu mbalimbali za lugha kisha awasilishe kazi yake kwa wenzake ili waitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Matumizi ya lugha katika shairi yana umuhimi gani kwa msomaji?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki kutambua mbinu za lugha kwenye mashairi aliyosoma.

Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapowasilishia wenzake shairi jepesi alilotunga akizingatia mbinu mbalimbali za lugha.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapofanya utafiti maktabani na mtandaoni kuhusu matumizi ya mbinu za lugha katika mashairi.

skills.name: Tambua mbinu za lugha na umuhimu wake katika shairi
skills.mastery: Explains the mbinu of a shairi read in class ("Sauti ya Mama Dunia") with a correct term, gives evidence from the text for every point, and says why it matters to the work, in 8 of 10 new items (longer written answers marked by the teacher).

misconceptions.error: Calls a comparison with kama a sitiari, or one without kama a tashbihi.

example.question: "Dunia ni mama analia" ni mbinu gani?

misconceptions.cause: Both compare; the child has not fixed which one uses kama, mithili ya or kana kwamba.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""Dunia ni mama analia" ni mbinu gani?" with "tashbihi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Circle kama, mithili ya, kana kwamba: present means tashbihi; absent means sitiari.
misconceptions.feedback: Tashbihi hulinganisha kwa kama au mithili ya; sitiari hulinganisha moja kwa moja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Names the device but cannot say what it does in the work.

misconceptions.cause: Devices have been taught as labels to find.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mbinu ya tashihisi katika "Dunia ni mama analia" ina umuhimu gani?" with "ni tashihisi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Always add "inasaidia..." after the label: picture, feeling, stress, humour.
misconceptions.feedback: Eleza kazi ya mbinu: inajenga picha, inasisitiza, inaonyesha hisia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads a figure of speech literally.

example.question: "Dunia ni mama analia" ina maana gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child reads the words, not the picture.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""Dunia ni mama analia" ina maana gani?" with "maana ya maneno kama yalivyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: is this really true? If not, what does the writer want us to see?
misconceptions.feedback: Lugha ya picha haina maana ya moja kwa moja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Does not notice repetition (takriri) or rhetorical questions as devices.

example.question: "Nitarudi, nitarudi, nitarudi!" ni mbinu gani?

misconceptions.cause: Repetition looks like a mistake to a child taught not to repeat words.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""Nitarudi, nitarudi, nitarudi!" ni mbinu gani?" with "kosa la uchapishaji" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the line aloud; what feeling does the repetition add?
misconceptions.feedback: Takriri ni kurudia neno au kifungu ili kusisitiza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Kubuni (Theme 13: Mshikamano wa kijamii)

skills.name: Andika insha ya maelezo kuhusu hali
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya maelezo from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a description or explanation with exact vocabulary, ordered paragraphs and vivid language; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Theme 11 maelezo with a point of view.
Grade 8 vivid maelezo of a place.

misconceptions.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Hali ya Kijiji Baada ya Mafuriko"?
example.correct_answer: Matope mazito yalifunika njia zote huku harufu ya mimea iliyooza ikienea kila kona.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Hali ya Kijiji Baada ya Mafuriko"?" with "Kijiji kilikuwa kibaya." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: States feelings with one word (nilihuzunika) and never shows them, so the reader feels nothing.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inamgusa msomaji zaidi?
example.correct_answer: Machozi yalinitiririka nilipoona kibanda chetu kikiteketea.

misconceptions.cause: Showing a feeling needs words for the body and the scene.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inamgusa msomaji zaidi?" with "Nilihuzunika." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Turn "nilihuzunika" into what the body did and what was seen.
misconceptions.feedback: Onyesha hisia kwa vitendo na picha, si kwa neno moja tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes in plain, flat words with no language devices (tashbihi, sitiari, methali, nahau) to make the insha vivid.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ina lugha ya kiubunifu kwa insha "Hali ya Kijiji Baada ya Mafuriko"?
example.correct_answer: Matope mazito yalifunika njia zote huku harufu ya mimea iliyooza ikienea kila kona.

misconceptions.cause: The child has not been shown how devices from fasihi can be used in his own writing.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ina lugha ya kiubunifu kwa insha "Hali ya Kijiji Baada ya Mafuriko"?" with "Kijiji kilikuwa kibaya." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Collect three devices from a class reader; rewrite one plain sentence with each.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia tashbihi, sitiari, methali au nahau kufanya insha iwe hai.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the whole insha as one paragraph with no utangulizi, kiini and hitimisho.

example.question: Insha "Hali ya Kijiji Baada ya Mafuriko" ina sehemu zipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child writes until the space is full and has not planned the parts.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Insha "Hali ya Kijiji Baada ya Mafuriko" ina sehemu zipi?" with "aya moja ndefu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Fold the page into three; one part in each; one idea per paragraph in the middle.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ina utangulizi, kiini chenye aya kadhaa, na hitimisho.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ukanushaji (Theme 13: Mshikamano wa kijamii)

kukanusha sentensi katika hali ya masharti ya -nge-, -ngali na -ki-katika kikundi,

Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.

skills.name: Kanusha hali ya masharti
skills.mastery: Mtoto hukanusha -nge- kwa -singe- (angekuja, asingekuja), -ngali- kwa -singali- na -ki- kwa -sipo- (akisoma, asiposoma). Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.feedback: -nge- hukanushwa kwa -singe-.

misconceptions.feedback: -ngali- hukanushwa kwa -singali-.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Negates -ngali- with ha- (hangalikuja) instead of -singali- (asingalikuja).

sub_strands.sub_strand: Mazungumzo (Theme 14: Matumizi ya kodi)

skills.name: Tambua aina za shajara na uandike shajara
skills.mastery: Tells shajara from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a dated diary entry of the right kind in the first person; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

misconceptions.error: Writes a diary entry with no date or day.

example.question: Kila ingizo la shajara huanza na nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child writes it like an insha.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kila ingizo la shajara huanza na nini?" with "anwani ya insha" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show a real diary page; each entry starts with the date.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila ingizo la shajara huanza na tarehe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes about himself in the third person (Juma aliamka...) in his own diary.

example.question: Shajara ya kibinafsi huandikwa kwa nafsi gani?

misconceptions.cause: Stories in class are often in the third person.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Shajara ya kibinafsi huandikwa kwa nafsi gani?" with "nafsi ya tatu: yeye" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Rewrite one entry with "mimi".
misconceptions.feedback: Shajara ya kibinafsi huandikwa kwa nafsi ya kwanza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Mixes the kinds of diary (shajara ya kibinafsi and shajara ya kazi or ya shule).

example.question: Shajara inayoorodhesha mikutano ya kazi ya wiki ni ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: All diaries look alike.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Shajara inayoorodhesha mikutano ya kazi ya wiki ni ya aina gani?" with "ya kibinafsi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Sort entries: feelings and personal events vs appointments and tasks.
misconceptions.feedback: Shajara ya kazi huandika shughuli na miadi; ya kibinafsi huandika hisia na matukio ya mtu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the entry as a letter (Mpendwa..., Wako...).

example.question: Ni mwanzo upi unafaa katika shajara?

misconceptions.cause: Letters are the personal writing the child knows.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mwanzo upi unafaa katika shajara?" with "Mpendwa rafiki," among the options.
misconceptions.help: Compare a letter and a diary entry: who reads each?
misconceptions.feedback: Shajara haina salamu wala hitimisho la barua.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Udogo na Ukubwa wa Nomino (Theme 14: Matumizi ya kodi)
learning_experiences: kuchopoa nomino katika hali ya udogo na ukubwa kwenye chati, kadi maneno, kapu maneno au tarakilishi,
kutambua viambishi vya udogo na ukubwa katika maneno,
kuandika majina ya vifaa vya darasani katika udogo na ukubwa,
kuambatanisha nomino za hali ya wastani na za hali ya udogo na ukubwa kwa usahihi kwenye chati za maneno,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi kwa kutumia nomino katika hali ya udogo au ukubwa,
kutunga sentensi akitumia nomino katika hali ya udogo na ukubwa kwa kuzingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la matumizi ya kodi,
kumtajia mzazi au mlezi wake majina ya vifaa vya nyumbani katika udogo na ukubwa.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni maneno gani unayoyajua yaliyo katika hali ya udogo na ukubwa?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kazi za kikundi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kiteknolojia kutambua nomino katika hali ya udogo na ukubwa.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi kuhusu suala lengwa akitumia nomino katika hali ya udogo na ukubwa.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua nomino katika hali ya udogo na ukubwa na kuzitungia sentensi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomtajia mzazi au mlezi wake nomino katika hali ya udogo na ukubwa katika mazingira ya nyumbani.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani na katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Ujuzi wa matumizi ya fedha: mwanafunzi anapoandika sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kutumia nomino katika hali ya udogo na ukubwa.

skills.name: Tambua nomino katika hali ya udogo na ukubwa
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua udogo (kijiji, kijiti, kitoto, kijumba) na ukubwa (jitu, jumba, joka), na hubadilisha nomino ipasavyo. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

misconceptions.error: Mixes udogo and ukubwa.

example.question: Kijiji ni nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "mji mkubwa" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kijiji ni mji mdogo.
misconceptions.feedback: Kijiji ni mji mdogo.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Changes the noun to big or small but leaves the adjective and verb in the ordinary class (jibwa kubwa anabweka).

misconceptions.cause: The child changes the noun only.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Jibwa ___ (-kubwa) ___ (bweka)." with "mkubwa anabweka" among the options.

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusikiliza kwa Kutathmini (Theme 15: Maadili ya kitaifa)
learning_experiences: kutafiti na kueleza maana ya kusikiliza kwa kutathmini,
kujadili na wenzake vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kutathmini mazungumzo kutoka kwenye mazungumzo mafupi,
kusikiliza mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa kutoka kwa mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali na kuyatathmini kwa kuzingatia vipengele mbalimbali,
kushiriki na mzazi au mlezi wake katika mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa na kutoa maoni kuhusu suala linalozungumziwa.
key_inquiry_questions: Kusikiliza kwa kutathmini mazungumzo kuna umuhimu gani?
Unazingatia nini katika kutathmini ufaafu wa mazungumzo?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na kuchangia katika kujadili kuhusu vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusikiliza kwa kutathmini.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikilizia mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa na kutathmini.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapotathmini yaliyozungumziwa na kutoa uamuzi kuhusu vipengele ambavyo vimetumiwa.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofanikiwa kutoa mtazamo wake kuhusu suala linalozungumziwa katika mazungumzo aliyoyasikiliza.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa na mzazi au mlezi wake na kujifunza zaidi vipengele vya kusikiliza kwa kutathmini.

Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na kuchangia katika shughuli za kikundi. ya kitaifa: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana wenzake katika mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa.

skills.name: Sikiliza na utathmini mazungumzo
skills.mastery: Names the features to keep in this kind of talk (kutathmini), picks the better of two ways to listen or reply in a situation on mchango wa vijana katika kudumisha amani, and takes part in one in standard Kiswahili, judged by the teacher with the KICD rubric; in the app, 8 of 10 new items right.

misconceptions.error: Accepts everything said as true, without checking the reasons or the source.

example.question: Mzungumzaji anasema: "Kila mtu anajua dawa hii hutibu magonjwa yote." Ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: kuuliza ushahidi na chanzo cha habari hiyo

misconceptions.cause: Speakers who sound sure are believed.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mzungumzaji anasema: "Kila mtu anajua dawa hii hutibu magonjwa yote." Ufanye nini?" with "kukubali" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask three questions of every claim: nani alisema, ushahidi gani, je ni kweli kwa wote?
misconceptions.feedback: Tathmini hoja kwa ushahidi kabla ya kukubali.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Judges the talk by the speaker (a friend is right, a stranger wrong).

example.question: Unatathmini mazungumzo. Unazingatia nini?

misconceptions.cause: Loyalty to friends.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unatathmini mazungumzo. Unazingatia nini?" with "nani anazungumza" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Judge two talks with names hidden.
misconceptions.feedback: Tathmini hoja, si mtu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Answers or speaks on something other than the topic (mchango wa vijana katika kudumisha amani).

example.question: Mada ni mchango wa vijana katika kudumisha amani. Ni mchango upi unafaa?
example.correct_answer: Tunaweza kuchangia mchango wa vijana katika kudumisha amani kwa njia hii...

misconceptions.cause: The child says what is on his mind.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mada ni mchango wa vijana katika kudumisha amani. Ni mchango upi unafaa?" with "Jana nilitazama filamu nzuri sana." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Repeat the topic before speaking; link your point to it in the first sentence.
misconceptions.feedback: Changia kuhusu mada inayojadiliwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Interrupts the speaker before he finishes.

example.question: Mwenzako bado anazungumza na una jambo la kusema. Ufanye nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child fears losing his idea.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwenzako bado anazungumza na una jambo la kusema. Ufanye nini?" with "mkatize ili usisahau" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Note the idea on paper; wait for the pause.
misconceptions.feedback: Msikilize mzungumzaji hadi amalize.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ufupisho (Theme 15: Maadili ya kitaifa)
learning_experiences: kujadili na wenzake vipengele vya ufupisho wa habari katika matini (kuzingatia maelekezo ya ufupisho, kueleza habari upya kwa maneno yake mwenyewe, kudondosha mifano na maelezo ya ziada, mpangilio wenye muwala),
kuandika ufupisho wa habari kwa kuzingatia vipengele vifaavyo na kuwasomea wenzake ili watoe maoni yao,
kusoma matini mbalimbali zikiwemo za mtandaoni na kufupisha habari kwa usahihi,

Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kusoma makala.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoeleza kwa kifupi makala aliyosoma.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposoma makala kutoka mtandaoni na kuyafupisha ipasavyo.

Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi. ya kitaifa: mwanafunzi anaposoma na kufupisha habari katika matini kuhusu suala lengwa.

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kujibu Baruapepe (Theme 15: Maadili ya kitaifa)

Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika baruapepe ipasavyo.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomwelezea mzazi au mlezi wake namna ya kujibu baruapepe.

skills.name: Jibu baruapepe kwa kuzingatia vipengele vifaavyo
skills.mastery: Tells baruapepe from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes an email with the receiver's address, a short subject, a greeting, the message in correct Kiswahili and a closing; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Answering a letter point by point.

misconceptions.error: Leaves the subject box empty or writes the whole message in it.

example.question: Katika baruapepe, kisanduku cha "Kichwa" kinaandikwa nini?
example.correct_answer: maneno machache yanayotaja ujumbe, kama "Jibu: Kongamano la Maadili ya Kitaifa"

misconceptions.cause: The child has used chat apps that have no subject line.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika baruapepe, kisanduku cha "Kichwa" kinaandikwa nini?" with "ujumbe wote" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show an inbox: the subject is all the reader sees before opening.
misconceptions.feedback: Kichwa cha baruapepe ni maneno machache yanayoeleza ujumbe unahusu nini.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes a postal address and a date at the top, as in a paper letter.

example.question: Baruapepe huanza vipi?
example.wrong_answer: S.L.P. 120, Nakuru, na tarehe juu kulia

misconceptions.cause: The paper letter is the model the child knows.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Baruapepe huanza vipi?" with "S.L.P. 120, Nakuru, na tarehe juu kulia" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Compare a paper letter and an email; the email programme adds the address and date.
misconceptions.feedback: Baruapepe haina anwani ya posta wala tarehe juu; kifaa huziweka chenyewe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the receiver's name, not the email address, in the "Kwa" box.

example.question: Kisanduku cha "Kwa" kinaandikwa nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child writes the person as on an envelope.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kisanduku cha "Kwa" kinaandikwa nini?" with "Amina Otieno" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show what an email address looks like (jina@mahali); practise reading it aloud.
misconceptions.feedback: Kisanduku cha "Kwa" huandikwa anwani ya baruapepe ya mpokeaji, yenye @.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes in short chat forms (sawa, poa, nkt, 2moro) and no closing.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika baruapepe?

misconceptions.cause: Chat habits come into the email.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika baruapepe?" with "Poa, tutaonana 2moro." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Rewrite one chat message as a short email with a greeting and a closing.
misconceptions.feedback: Baruapepe huandikwa kwa lugha sahihi, na humalizika kwa hitimisho na jina.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

kugeuza sentensi zilizo katika usemi halisi ziwe katika usemi wa taarifa,
kugeuza sentensi zilizo katika usemi wa taarifa ziwe katika usemi halisi,

skills.name: Jadili kanuni za kubadilisha usemi na uzitumie katika matini
skills.mastery: States the rules for turning direct speech into reported speech (marks, kwamba/kuwa or kama, person, tense, time and place words, questions and commands) and uses both kinds correctly in a passage, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 8 perfect tenses, used when the tense shifts back.

misconceptions.error: Reports a command with kwamba and the command form (Alisema kwamba nenda) instead of the -e form (aliniambia niende).

example.question: Badilisha: Mwalimu alisema, "Fungua dirisha."

misconceptions.cause: The child applies the statement rule (kwamba) to every kind of speech.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Badilisha: Mwalimu alisema, "Fungua dirisha."" with "Mwalimu alisema kwamba fungua dirisha." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Commands become ku-ambia + the -e form: aliniambia nifungue.
misconceptions.feedback: Amri katika usemi wa taarifa hutumia hali ya kuagiza: aliniambia nifungue.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Keeps -na- in the reported speech instead of moving it back (Alisema kwamba anaumwa, reported long after).

example.question: Badilisha (habari ya jana): Juma alisema, "Ninaumwa."

misconceptions.cause: The child keeps the tense of the words heard.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Badilisha (habari ya jana): Juma alisema, "Ninaumwa."" with "Juma alisema kwamba anaumwa." among the options.
misconceptions.help: When reporting later, -na- becomes alikuwa akiumwa (or -li-), -ta- becomes -nge-, -me- becomes alikuwa ame-.
misconceptions.feedback: Katika usemi wa taarifa, wakati husogea nyuma: alikuwa akiumwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Turns reported speech back into direct speech without restoring the person (Juma alisema, "Yeye atakuja.").

example.question: Badilisha kuwa usemi halisi: Juma alisema kwamba angekuja.

misconceptions.cause: The child adds the marks and forgets the other changes go back too.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Badilisha kuwa usemi halisi: Juma alisema kwamba angekuja." with "Juma alisema, "Yeye angekuja."" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Reverse every change: yeye -> mimi, -nge- -> -ta-, siku iliyofuata -> kesho.
misconceptions.feedback: Usemi halisi hurudisha maneno ya msemaji kama alivyoyasema: "Nitakuja."
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the comma or the question mark outside the speech marks, or starts the quoted words with a small letter.

example.question: Ni ipi imeandikwa sawa?

misconceptions.cause: Marks are placed where the child pauses.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ipi imeandikwa sawa?" with "Mama aliuliza "umekula"?" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Rule: comma before the opening mark; capital inside; the end mark inside the closing mark.
misconceptions.feedback: Koma kabla ya alama za mtajo, herufi kubwa ndani, na alama ya mwisho ndani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher
